tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// dpal nag po pas mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga'i lag len rab tu gsal bar byed pa

zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// nā mo shri tsa kra swa bha ra ya/ he ru ka dpal thod pa'i dum sogs dpa' bo rnams kyis rab bsngags shing*// rnal 'byor ma dpal dpa' mo rnams kyis bkra shis glu dbyangs rab tu sgrogs// ka khwa la sogs bgegs dpung bsnun byed thar pa'i grong khyer nyams dga' bar// ye shes lnga ldan dkyil 'khor 'khor lor 'od zer chen pos dbang bskur shog /'khor lo sdom pa rab gsungs pa// smin byed dkyil 'khor cho ga ni// spyod 'chang gsung gi rab phye ba// bde blag rtogs phyir 'dir gsal bya// rnal 'byor ma bla na med pa'i snying po dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar byed pa la gsum ste/ gang gis bskur ba'i slob dpon/ gang la bskur ba'i slob ma/ ji ltar bskur ba'i cho ga'i rim pa'o// dang po ni/ sdom 'byung las/ zhi zhing dul ba'i cha lugs can// sems can kun la mi 'jigs ster// sngags dang rgyud kyi rab sbyor shes// bstan chos rig cing snying brtser ldan// sems can kun la bu bzhin blta// thams cad du ni snyan par smra// pha rol phyin pa bcu spyod cing*// sems can rnams kyi mgon gyur pa// dbang bskur don gyi de nyid shes// tshig gsal yon tan rgya mtsho ste// rtag par rgyun du gnas brten pa/ de ni slob dpon rig par bya/ zhes byung ngo*// gzhan yang phyag na rdo rje'i 'grel pa la sogs par slob dpon nyid du rung ba dang mi rung ba rgya cher gsungs pa rtogs par bya'o/ slob ma ni/ 'jam zhing snyan par smra ba dang*// snying rje la sogs phan sems ldan// thos dang klog la mngon par brtson// gsang ba'i chos la mngon par dad// rtag par rgyun du bla ma gus// slob ma de ni yongs su bzung*// zhes byung bas mtshan nyid dang ldan pas lan gsum du gsol ba btab nas/ yo byad 'tshogs par nus pa na sbyin par bya'o// gsum pa cho ga ni bzhi ste/

sngon du bsnyen pa dang*/ sa chog dang*/ lhag gnas dang*/ dngos gzhi'o// dang po ni/ dpa' bo'i snying po'i gsang sngags ni// khri phrag gsum du bzlas brjod bya// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo'i// khri phrag gnyis ni bsnyen pa bya// ka khwa la sogs rnam pa brgyad// snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi ni// stong phrag lnga dang lnga brgyad ni// sngon du bsnyen pa bya ba ste// bdag gam yang na dkyil 'khor ni// sngon du bsnyen pas 'grub par 'gyur// zhes so// sa'i cho ga ni gnas khyad par can// ri dang nags dang sman ljongs dang*// rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram dang ni// gdod na grub pa'i dur khrod dang*// yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs ni// gang yang sems ni 'jug pa dang*// der ni dkyil 'khor brtsam par bya /dus ni dgun zla 'bring dang dpyid 'bring dang*// bcu dang nya stong bcu bzhi la// dbang bskur rab tu gnas pa bya// gza' skar sbyor ba bzang dus shing*// de ltar gnas dang dus 'dzom nas// sngar sbyang ba mabyas pa yin na/ gnas kyi bdag po mi dang mi ma yin pa la bden pa'i tshig gis blangs la/ gzhi'i bdag po la gtor ma byin te/ sa'i lha mo la sa slang ba'i rim pa ni/ gzhi der me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams nas/ rang yi dam du bskyed nas thugs kha nas 'od zer gyis bskul bar mos te/ lag pa rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya'am rdo rje dang bcas pas hūm̐ zhes pa la lan gsum bsnun pas/ lam̐ las sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa g.yon bum pa g.yas dam bca' khas len pa'i phyag rgya can bskyed la/ oṃ tshur spyon tshur spyon lha mo che// sa'i lha mo 'jig rten yum// rin chen kun gyis rab gang ba// mchog gi rgyan gyis rab tu brgyan// mgul do zhabs gdub sil sil bcas// rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod ma// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' yis ni// skad cig nyid la 'dir spyon cig

oṃ laṃ bha su dha ri dza hūm̐ bam̐ ho zhes bkug la/ oṃ pra ti dhe bi/ pra ba ra sa ta ka ra argaṃ pra ti tsa ye hūm̐/ zhes mchod yon dang*/ de bzhi du pa t+yam̐ dang*/ a dza ma na/ pro k+ṣa nam̐ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ 'thor 'thung phul la/ phyi'i mchod pas mchod la/ gtor ma yang byin gyis brlabs me rlung gi sbyor bas bya ste/ oṃ lam̐ a hūm̐ bha su dha ri bha ling ta khā khā kha hi khā hi zhes byin nas bstod pa ni/ ma ma rin chen sna tshogs 'dzin// sku phyed thon te gser gyi mdog /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan// lha mo zhal cig phyag gnyis ma// bum pa dam bca'i phyag rgya can// khyod ni sa 'dzin lha mo ste// sa 'og gtso mo khyod la 'dud// ces bstod nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// shākya seng ge'i skyob pa yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las// rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri// zhes lan gsum du brjod nas/ gnang ba byin te de nyid du thim par bsams la/ mchod yon sbyin no// de nas sa las dang bya bas sbyangs te/ pus nub tsam du brkos te sa kha dog dkar ba la sogs pa bzang po dri dang ro khyad par can ni bsngags so// rin chen la sogs pa byung na ni dge'o// dri dang ro ngan pa dang ra dang rus pa dang sol ba la sogs pa byung na bsal la/ zhal bzhi pa'i sngags kyis bsang ste gzhan du 'pho la/ gzhan nas sa bzang po blangs te/ sman lnga dang dri bzang po dang bdud rtsi lnga dang rin po che lnga rnams bsres pas bkang la dkyil 'khor bya'o// mtshan nyid kyang khru gang pa la sogs pa nas/ ci srid bcu gnyis bcu drug bar// shar dang byang du gzhol ba ni// sngags rnams kyis ni dngos grub 'gyur// dbus su mtho bas rgyal srid dam// rig pa 'dzin pa'iganas dag thob// zhes so// gzhan rigs kyi khyad par la sogs pa rgya cher ni kho bos dus 'khor gyi cho gar bstan to// sbyang ba mi dgos pa yang rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/

khang bzang rdo ste sa gzhi dang ni// gtsug lag khang dang zhabs kyis bcags// ba glang lhas dang rgya mtsho'i 'gram// lag pa rdo rje sa gnon byas// rang gi snying po brgya rtsa bzlas// de las sbyang ba bya mi dgos// zhes byung bas rang gi snying po dang sa'i lha mo la gtor ma tsam bya ba nyid yin no// de ltar nyi ma dang por byas nas/ de nas ba glang gi lci ba dang bdud rtsi lngas dkyil 'khor byugs la bgegs bsal bar bya ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rdo rje slob dpon 'dug ste/ rgyan drug gis brgyan zhing he ru ka bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom par bya'o// phyogs bzhi nas las byed pas mchod pa lnga dang chu bzhi dang*/ lag pa'i mchod pa la sogs pa byas te/ rkang pa brgyad pas kyang bstod nas bskul zhing gsol ba gdab pa ni/ shar phyogs nas mkha' 'gro mas// de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// chos kun bdag med pa'i mchog/ dkyil 'khor dam pa bstan du gsol// byang phyogs nas lā mas// mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs// mtshan min thams cad yang dag spangs/ kun du bzang po sku'i mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bstan du gsol/ nub phyogs nas dum skyes mas/ zhi ba'i chos mchog las byung ba// ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong mdzad// kun du bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ lho phyogs nas gzugs can mas// sems can kun gyi sems chen po// rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med// kun du bzang po thugs kyi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bstan du gsol// zhes glus bskul nas/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon thams cad la brtse ba'i sems kyis/ nyon mongs pa dang bdud kyi gnas la khro bas/ rdo rje hūm̐ gi rang bzhin gyis bgegs bsal ba bya ba dang*/ rkang pa gnyis su hūm̐ las rdo rje dang*/ mig g.yas su ma las nyi ma 'bar ba dang*/ g.yon du ta las bzla ba bsgoms te lus thams cad las rdo rje dang 'bar ba 'phro bas log 'dren thams cad 'bros par bsams nas/

rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin cing kha ṭ+wām̐ ga 'khyud pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su g.yo ba'i gar gyis langs la mnyam pa'i rkang stabs kyis sangs rgyas thams cad la 'og nas bshad pa'i sngags kyis phyag byas la/ rdo rje'i 'gros kyis dbang ldan song zhing rdo rje'i lta bas bltas la/ ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas thams cad dgongs su gsol// rdo rje 'dzin pa che ge bdag /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ni// sems can kun gyi don du bgyi// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// lus ngag yid la gnas pa yi// bgegs kyi tshogs rnams nga la nyon// nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor byed// rdo rje 'bar ba'i lus kyis ni// lus gsum las skyes 'gengs par byed// gal te nga las gang 'da' ba// 'jig par 'gyur bar gdon mi za// sa phyogs 'dir sems can gyi don rtsom gyis/ lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang*/ dri za dang 'byung po dang*/ sha za mo dang srin mo la sogs pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs gang dag gnas pa'i bdag po rnams myur du song zhig 'di ltar dpal he ru ka'i bka' thos nas myur ba nyid du song zhig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag nga'i ye shes kyi rdo rje dang*/ kha ṭ+wām̐ gas spyi bo rnam pa brgyar 'gas par bya'o// zhes lan gsum du brjod la hūm̐ hūm̐ gi sgra dang bcas rdo rje'i gar bya'o// de yang g.yas dang g.yon du bskor ba dang*/ rol pas rab tu 'phyang ba dang*/ rol pa'i gom stabs bcas pa las/ gom pa brgyad pas gar bya'o/ zhes pas rdo rje rtse gsum pa la sogs pa'i 'gros kyis shes rab thabs sbyor dang ldan pas bskor la/ shar du g.yas brkyang ba g.yas rdo rje 'phen pa'o// lhor g.yon brkyang ba rdo rje mda'i 'phen no// nub tu sa ga dang pad ma'i phyag rgya'o// byang du zlum po dang gtun shing ngo*// phyogs mtshams nges med du/ gyen du lte ba dang*/

thur du bskyod pa dang*/ thad kar bskyod pa dang mnyam pa zhes bya ba rnams gom pa brgyad pa ste/ mnyam pa'i rkang stabs g.yas g.yon brkyang*// zlum po sa ga gyen du 'degs// thur du bskyod dang thad sogs bskyod// gom brgyad g.yas g.yon bskor gar bya// zhes so// gar gyi nyams kyang*/ rkang pa bskyod dang lag pa bskyod// smin ma 'degs par byed pa dang*// cung zad ngo tsha'i mig zur dang*// bla rgyas lta na sdug pa dang*// mig yang gar ni byed 'gyur zhing*// kha yi pad ma 'dzum dang bcas// cung zad dmar ba'i mche ba 'chang*// kun dha ltar dkar so yi phreng*// dpal ldan khrag 'thung rnal 'byor che// sems can sgrol ba rmad du byung*// de la sogs pa'i gar gyis ni// bgegs la sogs pa bskrad par bya// zhes pas 'di nyid dam/ yang na rdo rje phreng bar byung ba lta bu gnas skabs dang sbyar te bya'o// de nas gur bya ba/ zhal bzhi la sogs sngags kyis ni// phur bu ra ba dra ba bya/ dang po sum bha la sogs pas khwa gdong ma la sogs pa spro zhing*/ rgyu gang yang rung pa'i phur pa bcu byin gyis brlabs la/ gha gha la sogs pa'i sngags kyis phyogs mtshams su btab cing brdungs nas/ rdo rje ra ba dang dra gur mtshams bcing ba mngon rtogs ltar bya'o// de dag ni sa'i cho ga'o// de nas lhag par gnas pa la bzhi ste/ lha lhag par gnas pa dang*/ bum pa lhag gnas dang*/ sbyin bsreg dang*/ slob ma lhag par gnas pa'o// dang po ni maṇ+ḍal bdud rtsi lngas byugs te/ lha thams cad kyi gnas su/ dri'i thig le gtso bo la gru bzhi gzhan zlum po byas te/ so so'i sngags kyis me tog bkod la/ mchod pa dang gtor ma yang bshams te/ lag pa'i mchod pa sngon du song bas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rten dang brten bar bcas pa bskyed la/ ye shes pa dgug cing mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa'i bar du phyi rol gyi mchod pa ltar byas te/

de nas snyan gsan dbab par bya ba ni/ rdo rje dril bu dang spos thogs la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngags kyis mchod pa sngon du song bas/ dbyangs dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba// khyab bdag dngos kun bdag nyid can// ston pa'i gtso bo khrag 'thung dpal// phag mor lhan cig yang dag ldan// gang zhig phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang*// rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can// byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// slob ma la ni phan pa dang*/ khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// rdo rje can dag 'di zhes pas// nang par dkyil 'khor bri bar bgyid// rjes su brtse bas nyer dgongs te// kun gyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab po// la ba pa'i cho ga las byung ba'ang byas kyang rung ngo*// lha rnams kyis gnang ba byin par bsams la/ u ti ṣ+ṭa zhes nam mkha' la bteg la bzhag go /lha lhag par gnas pa'o// de nas bum pa lhag par gnas pa ni/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bum pa rin po che'am sa las byas pa'ang rung ste/ bcu la/ legs par bkrus te gu gul gyis bdug yungs dkar gyis sum bha la sogs pa'i sngags kyis brabs la bgegs bsal te/ gos ma nyams pas mgul chings bya ste/ chu gtsang ma dang dkar gsum dang bu ram dang sbyar bas nang bkang la/ gser dngul mu tig byi ru dang*/ nas gro til 'bras sran ma dang*/ bh+ri ha ti kan ta ka ri/ a pa ra tsi ta/ dan dhod pa la/ ha sa dhe ba dang*/ tsan dan dang a ka ru/ du rus ka/ gla rtsi dang ga pur/ bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas pa gzhug cing*/ 'bras bu can gyis kha brgyan te/ rnam par rgyal ba la rdo rje gri gug /shar 'khor lo dang rdo rje/ lho rin chen/ nub pad ma/ byang ral gri phyag mtshan btags so// las bum la gri gug go /dgod pa ni ras la sogs pa'i steng du'am yang na sngar gyi lha lhag gnas kyi sa de nyid du byas te/

sgo dang gra yi mtha' ru brgyad// bum pa dgu pa dbus su bzhag /las bum lho yi phyogs kyi ni// ri mo'i dbus su bzhag par bya// de la mchod pa ci ltar 'byor pas bskor te/ 'dir ma gsungs kyang legs par byas pa'i thig skud shar du/ rdul tshon nub tu/ rdo rje lho ru/ dril bu byang du/ dbu rgyan lho ru/ rus rgyan kha ṭ+wām̐ ga la sogs rjes gnang gi yo byad rnams nub bam gang bder bzhag /ces byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel par gsungs so// sta gon dang dngos gzhi'i dus na'ang 'di ltar bkod pa legs so// de nas yang bdag bskyed las 'od 'phros pas bum pa rnams sbyangs la/ lha rnams bskyed de bum pa'i steng du bdud rtsi'i chu dang bcas pa'i snod bzhag cing de'i steng du rdo rje gzungs thag dang bcas pa bkod la/ yi ge bdun pa dang sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'i sngags kyis sam/ yang na lha thams cad kyi sngags kyang rung ste thun cig bzlas so// las bum du ni khan dha ro hi'i bzlas pa byas la/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo bkug cing bcug la mchod de/ bstod pa ni/ mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod// rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che// rdo rje zhi ba dgyes pa che// rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /'khor lo mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod// rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab// rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med// rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med// rin chen mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che// mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin// 'dod chags pha rol phyin pa mnyes/ pad ma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod// don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa// dag pa'i ngo bo nyid las byung*// sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces bstod la/

oṃ badz+ra u ta ke hūm̐ gis lha rnams zhu bar byas te dung chos kyi chu blugs te bzhag go /de dang dus gcig tu rdo rje la sogs pa rnams kyang rang bzhin gyis byin gyis brlab bo// bum pa lhag par gnas pa'o// de nas sbyin bsreg long dang sbyar la bya'o// cho ga gzhan du bstan no// long med na mchod pa'i skabs su nang gi sbyin bsreg bya bar bshad do// de nas slob ma lhag par gnas pa ni/ las thams cad pa'i bum pas khrus byas la/ maṇ+ḍal gzhan nas bshad pa ltar phul la/ me tog dang bcas pa'i slob la ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang sbyin/ gzhan don la bskul gsol ba gdab/ spro ba bskyed cing nyan par gdams/ lnga rnam dag bya/ thun mong gi sems bskyed dang sdom pa sbyin/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab go chas bsrung*/ so shing dang*/ skyor chu/ srung skud/ ku sha sbyin/ chos bshad par bya ste/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang ni rang nyid he ru kar mos pa'i hūm̐ las 'od byung ste/ slob ma rnams kyis gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad lhar gyur cing bdag nyid kyi zhal du bsdus la sku rgyud de gsang ba nas yum gyi mkhar lha'i rnam par gyur pa slob ma'i cha byad du bsgyur la bzhag ste/ 'di ni rgyud thams cad nas gsungs shing gsang sgrogs su mi 'gro ba yin gsung*/ de nas bla mas 'di skad brjod de/ khyed rnams rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thob cing*/ de las kyang rdo rje'i theg pa rnal 'byor ma bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa ni sngon du sbyangs pa du ma song zhing*/ dpal he ru ka nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs pa yin te kun tu spyod pa las/ dad pa yang dag bskyed pa dang*// rnal 'byor brtson la gnas pa ni// skye ba bye ba stong phrag tu// nga yi ye shes kyis bskul yin// zhes gsungs pas de yang 'di ltar du nges par bya'o// sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni 'jug par bya// bsod nams 'dod pa de las gzhan// gzhan ni 'jig rten pha rol gnyer// slar yang dad dang ldan pa yis// 'jig rten pha rol la dmigs te// blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug par bya// 'di yi 'bras bu mi gnyer ste// gal te 'di 'bras don gnyer na// 'jig rten pha rol 'grub mi 'gyur// 'jig rten pha rol ma dmigs na// 'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub// zhes gsungs pas zhe thag pa nas phyi ma'i bla na med pa'i byang chub bsgrub po snyam du mdzod la/

gsol ba 'debs pas/ lad mo mdzod ces brjod la/ dpa' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan par/ mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// sdom pa rnams kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal// zhes lan gsum bya'o// de la lan gsum du bla mas spro ba bskyed cing nyan par bskul te/ bu tshur theg pa chen po las/ khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// gsang sngags spyod pa'i cho ga ni// khyod la yang dag bshad par bya// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang*// da ltar byung ba rdzogs sangs rgyas// 'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa kun// de dag kun gyi gsang sngags kyi// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan med mnyes// gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med de// skyob pa dpal ldan he ru kas// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa// dpung chen bdag kyang de yis bcom// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni// shin tu bsam pa bzang po ldan pas nyon// brjed ngas blo la he ru ka sogs pa// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlobs// ces brjod la de don yang bshad do// rnam dag dang sems bskyed pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dmigs te lus gus pas phyag 'tshal/ lus longs spyod dang bcas pa 'bul zhing*/ thog ma med pa nas lus ngag yid kyis byas pa dang*/ byed du bcug pa'i sdig pa thams cad zhe thag pa nas bshags/ so so skye bo dang*/ nyan thos/ rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dge ba thams cad la rjes su yid rang*/

gzhan don du skyabs su 'gro/ sems bskyed de sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mdzad pa ltar bdag gis kyang bya/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du gyur cig snyam pa byas la/ lad mo byed du bcug ste/ bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis dang*// bgyid du rtsal dang yid rang pa// sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas ni// de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyi// bsgom dang bzlas brjod bsod nams la// de la bdag ni yid rang ngo*// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba la// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// mya ngan 'da' bar bzhed rnams la// mya ngan mi 'da' gsol bar bgyid// sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas nas// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi mchog /de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi// sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji lta bar// skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis// byang chub sems ni bskyed pa ltar// de bzhin du ni sems bskyed do// bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis// 'jig rten 'dir ni myur du sangs rgyas shog /'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston bgyid cing*// sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir las sgrol// zhes bya ba'am/ yang na mngon rtogs kyis/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// zhes bya ba la sogs pas byas kyang rung ngo*// de nas sngags kyi dam tshig sbyin pa ni/ dam tshig dang sdom pa yang dag par bzung snyam pas khas blang bar bya'o// lad mo byed du bcug ste/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can// kun la rtag tu skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo// byang chub sems dpa'i bdag nyid che// khyad par du ni slob dpon la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs dpa' bo// rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag gis dus 'di nas bzung nas// ji srid gnyis med la gnas par// de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med pa// nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bsrung*// zhes brjod du bcug nas/

de la nyi shu rtsa gnyis ni 'di yin te/ rtsa ba'i dam tshig bcu bzhi dang*/ yan lag brgyad yod de/ bla ma la mi brnyas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' las mi 'da'/ rdo rje spun la mi khro/ sems can la byams pa bskyed/ kun rdzob don dam gyi byang chub kyi sems mi spang*/ rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' la zhe sdang gis mi smad/ gsang ba ma smin pa la mi bsgrag phung po la mi smad dag pa'i don la the tshom mi bya/ lam log pa yal bar mi dor/ ming tshig bral ba la rtog pas sgro mi gdags/ dad ldan sun mi dbyung*/ bza' ba dang bca' ba'i dam tshig brten/ phyi nang gi shes rab la mi smad pa ni rtsa ba'i dam tshig go /yan lag ni/ dam tshig med pa mi brten pa dang*/ tshogs kyi sar 'thab rtsod mi bya/ ma smin pa la dam tshig gi rdzas mi blang*/ snod ldan la chos mi gsang*/ theg chen 'dod pa la gzhan gyi gtam mi bstan/ nyan thos kyi nang du zhag bdun las mi bsdad/ mi shes par sngags par khas mi blang*/ phyi'i chos bstan rgyu la nang gi chos mi bshad pa ste/ de ltar 'di dag tshul bzhin du ma nyams par bya'o// de nas slob ma rnams he ru ka zhal cig phyag gnyis par mos pa byas la/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying khar hūm̐ dkar dmar sngo ba bsgom du gzhug ste/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pas dri'i thig le bya'o// de ma thag tu skyes pa la dpa' bo'i go cha/ bud med la dpa' mo'i go chas bsrung ngo*// so shing sbyin pa ni/ a shad tha la sogs pa'i shing la so shing sor bcu gnyis pa rtse mor me tog gi phreng can byas te/ sa gzhi ba glang gi lci bas byugs pa'am tshom bu byas la dor bar bya ba ni slob ma shar du kha bltas te mi smra bar ni so shing bca'/ phan tshun du yang mi dor ro// so shing mdun du dang por dor/ oṃ badz+ra ha sa ham̐ dhan ta sho dha ni hūm̐ zhes byin nas dor bar bya'o// mtshan ma ni/ de'i rtse mo gyen du bstan na mchog 'grub/

shar du 'bring po/ mtshams su 'jig rten gyi dngos grub/ thur du sa 'og gi dngos grub thob ces spyi rgyud las so// yang na phyogs rnams 'phrin las dang sbyar te bshad do// de nas skyor chu ni/ las thams cad pa'i chu sarba bhud dha'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ hri bhi shud dha sarba dharma sarba pa pam̐ ni sa tsa ya/ s+yam̐ sho dha pa bhi ka la pa a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes 'thung du gzhug /de ni rnam par rtog pa dang dri ma dag par byed pa yin gsung*/ de nas bsrung skud sum bsgril la yi ge bdun pa'i sngags kyis mdud pa byas te/ skyes pa'i g.yon pa/ bud med kyi g.yas la btags te/ oṃ bhud dha me tra'i rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sarban du swāhā/ zhes brjod do// ku sha'i sngas sbyin pa ni/ ku sha chun po gnyis lag pa g.yas g.yon du byin la/ oṃ badz+ra tig sna hūm̐ zhes brjod de/ gcig sngas su chug gcig stan du gyis la rmi lam gyi ltas blta bar bya'o// zhes sbyin no// de nas zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos bstan pa/ rnam snang mngon byang las gsungs pa brjod de/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams// u dum 'bar ba'i me tog bzhin// rgya lam na ni re 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung srid// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung pa// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis mnyam med sems can don// mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus// bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sngon chad sdig pa byas pa gang*// de kun dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra ba// mthong bas byang bar 'gyur bas na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i// tshul la gnas pa smos ci dgos// skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni// go 'phang bla na med par 'gro// gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la// blo gros shin tu mi g.yo ba// de dag gis ni ngan 'gro'i rgyu// sdug bsngal kun 'byung rab tu bcad// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis// rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas la// bdag nyid chen po kun gyis ni// bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun// yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa// de phyir khyed rnams theg chen la// dbang thob rab tu skye bar 'gyur// theg pa chen po cher 'byung pa'i// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// lam 'dir khyod nyid 'gro 'gyur bas// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/

lam 'di la brten nas/ myur du yon tan thams cad thob par 'gyur bas spros pa dang ldan par gyis shig /ces brjod do// de nas gtor ma dang mchod pa'o// nub mo rmi lam brtags la/ bzang na dngos grub thob par lung bstan/ ngan na bgegs la gtor ma byin la/ sum bha ni la sogs pas bsrung ba bya'o// slob ma lhag par gnas pa ste nub gnyis pa'i bya ba'o// de nas nub gsum pa'i snga dro dkyil 'khor dri dang bdud rtsi lngas byugs la dang po'i thig gdab par bya ste/ ro ras la sogs pa lnga bsgril la rigs lnga'i sa bon gyis byin gyis brlabs pa/ oṃ pra yad ts+tsha sha sha ta pu tram̐ s+ya/ tsakra pu tra na ya hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ rad na pad ma badz+ra khar kha zhes bya bas gsol ba btab pa/ sngags 'dis gcig tu bsgril/ oṃ a n+yo na a nud gha ta sarba dharma pa ra ta ra a nud gha ta sarba dharma ar+yan ta a nu bra bhi ta sarba dharma hūm̐/ zhes legs par bya shing mtshams pas dza dza dza zhes brjod nas/ nam mkha' la ye shes kyi thig gdab po/ de ni dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi'o// 'di nyid nas/ ji srid srad bu lnga ru ni// rnam par phye ste bcos nas su// dpal ldan khrag 'thung la sogs kun// spyan drangs nas ni de ru bzhugs// sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro ma// rtsa ba'i sngags dang gnyis med pas// pad ma'i snod la legs bzhag cing*// rang byung me tog dag gis mchod// ye shes thig ni bskyed nas su// mkhas pas thig ni gdab par bya// zhes pas oṃ ā badz+ra sa ma ya su triṃ ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing gdab ste ye shes kyi thig go /de nas las kyi skud pas byas te/ rdo rje khu tshur dang bcas pas bya'o// cha bcu drug gam nyi shu gang yang rung ba bya ste/ shar nub lho byang mtshams su gdab// phyogs bzhi de nas lo ma gsum// bcad na bcu drug cha ru 'gyur// dang drug phyed gdab phyi ma gdab// gnyis bdun cha bzhi mnyam por bya// lnga brgyad dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab// nang ni cha brgyad khor yug bzhi// khor yug cha phran re re ste// 'khor lo gsum par ka ba rgyan// gzhan rnams dkyil 'khor kun dang mthun// zhes bya ba bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad do// de nas rin chen lnga'am dur khrod kyi rdzas dang mtshon gang yang rung ba rigs lngas byin gyis brlabs la/

mchod nas/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis khu tshur gyis tshon bzung la/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste// sems can khams rnams rab sgrol byed// dpal ldan khrag 'thung rgyal po nyid// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba// tshon gyi las ni yang dag brtsam// zhes brjod de dbus nas cung zad bkye la phyis gzhan gyis bya'o// kha dog ni dbus mthing kha/ pad ma ni shar mthing*/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lhor ser/ mtshams de nyid spel ma'am yang na ljang khu bya bar stod 'grel nas byung ngo*// thugs kyi 'khor lo sngo ba/ gsung dmar/ sku dkar/ gzhi ni phyi ma phyi ma'o// khyams phyogs mdog re ga ni nag ljang ser dmar dkar rim pa'o// snam bu dmar/ pha gu ser/ dra phyed sngo/ gzeng khang ni dmar ljang*/ kra ma shi sha ni sna tshogs rdo rje'o// rta babs dang rdo rje dur khrod rdo rje me ri dang rgyan thams cad mdzes par bya'o// phyag mtshan ni dbus rdo rje gri gug mkha' 'gro bcu gnyis ni gri gug 'khor lo gsum ni/ rdo rje pad ma 'khor lo bya'o// khor yug rnams kyang de nyid do// yang na sa bon nam lha nyid dgod par yang gsungs so// de nas brgyan par byas te/ mchod pa thams cad dang bum pa dang*/ mda' dang rgyal mtshan dang*/ rin po che dang*/ ral gri dang*/ ji ltar 'byor pa bya'o// dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba'o// de nas dkyil 'khor bsgrub par bya ste/ thog mar shar phyogs su rang nyid dkyil 'khor bskyed cing ye shes gzhug pa mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar du bya'o// de nas rdul tshon bskyed pa ye shes gzhug pa'i bar du bya'o// sngar gyi lha nam mkhar bteg pa yang dbyer med du bya'o// de ni dkyil 'khor dam tshig pa bsgrub pa'o// yang sangs rgyas thams cad rang nyid kyi khar zhugs shing*/ mkhar phab la dkyil 'khor 'khor lo la gzhug cing*/ spros pa la dga' na mchod 'phreng ltar spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol bya ba// de ltar thon nas rig ma bcu drug dang*/

rgyal srid la sogs pas kyang mchod nas bstod pa bya'o// sngags brgya bzlas te brtan par bya'o// de yang*/ rang nyid ji ltar grub pa ni/ ye shes 'khor lo rnam par bsgom// bdag nyid kha sbyar sbyor ba yis// dam tshig la ni 'jug par bya// zhes bya ba nas/ gsang sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas// byin gyis brlabs la mngon par mchod/ ces pa'i bar du gsungs so// dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing mchod pa'o// de nas rdo rje slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug pa/ khrus dang maṇ+ḍal nas brtsams nas/ cho ga ci rigs pas dbang blangs la/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ rang nyid sngon nyid nas grub pa'i nus pa bskyed cing brtan par bya ste/ bden pa brjod pa/ nam mkha' las byung mtshan ldan phyir// thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin// bde mchog 'khor lor bdag bsgrubs mdzad// kun mchog yon tan chen po ste// dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha// rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal// mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag bsgrub mdzod// nyes pa mi mnga' brtag pa ste// 'dod chags kun gyi rjes chags pa// 'dod chags chen po dga' ba che// bcom ldan de nyid bdag bsgrubs mdzod// shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs// kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid// byang chub sems dpar bdag bsgrubs mdzod// kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste// dbang phyug chen po phyag rgya mchog /grub pa'i rdo rjes cher bstod pa// rdo rje snyems par bdag bsgrubs mdzod// sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa/ sems can kun gyi yid la gnas// sems can kun gyi yab nyid de// 'dod chags mchog gi dam tshig mchog /zhes pa dang*/ shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor 'dir// bden pa gang gis ye shes mchog /bden pa de yis mgon khyed kyis// bdag gi 'dod pa yongs rdzogs mdzad// chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu byung*// de bzhin de kho na las byung*// bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor du// gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma ni// kun gyis bsgrib med mthong bar shog

/ces brjod la/ phyi nang gi mchod pa sbyin bsreg ltar bya bar gsungs so// rdo rje slob dpon 'jug pa'o// de nas slob ma rnams yol ba'i phyi rol du las kyi bum pas khrus byas la/ maṇ+ḍal phul cing*/ thal mo sbyar te 'dug pa la/ slob dpon gyi/ kye kye dag sdug pa khyod su yin/ lan du slob mas/ kye bde ba chen po bdag ni bskal pa bzang po'o/ khyed ci 'dod/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig nod 'tshal lo// zhes dris lan byas pa'i rjes la/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i go chas bsrung*/ oṃ a kham̐ bhi ra hūm̐ gis spyan dar bcing*/ de yang mchog la ni mi mngon par sman pa la legs par dga' bar bya'o// de skad du/ go cha che la sogs pas bsrung*// dar dpyangs dag kyang bcing bar bya// zhes so// de nas slob dpon gyis 'di skad du/ khyed rnams de ltar dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa la/ gong nas gong ma'i sdom pa ni// bu khyod kyis ni bsrung byas te// grol ba'i rgyu ni de las gzhan// thabs ni cung zad yod ma yin// zhes gsungs pa sngags kyi sems bskyed pa rigs lnga'i sdom pa thob par bya dgos pas gsol ba gdab bo// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo'i// rnal 'byor gnas la bdag phyag 'tshal// zhes bya ba dang*/ slob dpon du dbang bskur na/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang*// dam pa bdag la bstsal nas ni// mgon po 'khor lo lha dag gi /de nyid slob dpon 'phrin las dang*// sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*// sdom pa gsang mchog bshad du gsol// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon bgyid// ces lan gsum gsol ba btab nas/ de nas slob ma rnams lhar gsal ba'i snying khar/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin de'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/

stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin bsgom du bcug la/ rdo rje snying khar bzung ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ yo ga tsi ta ud pa ta ya mi/ su ra ta sa ma ya stam̐ ho/ swi dha badz+ra ya thā su kham̐/ zhes brjod do// de ni sngon bcom ldan 'das la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dbang bskur ba'i snga ltas su rang gi kun rdzob don dam gyi ngo bor snang ngo zhes byung ngo// da ni de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i sdom pa 'di rnams kyang ngas bsgrag cing khyed rnams kyis khas blangs te lad mo bya'o// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming che ge zhes bya ba// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas kyang*// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa mchog ni bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyis ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sdom pa sangs rgyas rnal 'byor 'byung*// de nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi// rdo rje chen po'i rigs bsdus la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// de nyid du ni bzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi// rin chen chen po'i rigs mchog gi /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ pad ma chen po'i rigs dag pa'i// byang chub chen po 'byung ba la// phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum// dam chos so sor bzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs chen bsdus pa la// sdom pa thams cad yang dag ldan// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bzhin// kun nas so sor gzung bar bgyi// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis shing*// sdom pa ma lus bzung bgyis nas// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis sgrol// dbugs ma byung rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod// ces lan gsum mam cig kyang rung ngo*// de ltar sdom pa bzung nas/

da ni nang du 'jug pa'i don du gsol ba gdab pa/ don dam smra ba'i rnal 'byor seng ge zhes bya ba// nyon mongs spyod pa'i don la shin du mkhas gyur pa// srid pa'i nyes brgya bskyed rtsa'i nyon mongs chom mdzod la// rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po de nyid grub par mdzod// ces slob ma rnams kyis brjod du bcug nas/ bla mas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi// zhes nang du khrid la de nas dkyil 'khor 'khor lo gsal bar gnas pa la phyag gsum byas te gnas gsum du thal mo sbyar la/ oṃ na ma te hūm̐/ na ma mi hūm̐/ na mo na ma hūm̐/ zhes sku gsung thugs kyi phyag byas la/ de nas shar nas/ oṃ sarba bhi ra yo gi ni/ pu tso paṣ+ṭha na ya/ adha ma naṃ nir+ya ya mī/ sarba ta thā gā ta bhi ra yo ki ni/ a dha ma dha ka ni/ a ti ti ṣ+ṭha sa maṃ/ de nas byang nas/ oṃ sarba bhi ra yo ki ni pu tso a bhi ṣe ka ya/ a dha ma nam̐ nir+ya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ bhi ra yo gi ni/ a dha ma la ma ya a bhi shin tsi tu mam̐/ de nas nub nas/ oṃ sarba bhi ra yo gi ni/ pu tso pra bhar ta na ya/ adha ma nam̐ nir+ya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga bhi ra yo gi ni a dham ru bhin dha ro ha dharma pra bar ta ya mam̐/ de nas lho nas/ oṃ sarba bhi ra yo gi ni pu tso kar ma ya ad ma nam̐ nir+ya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta bhi ra yi ni ad ma ru pi ni ar+ya kar ma ku ru mam̐/ zhes phyag bzhi tshar nas/ dam bsgrag par bya ba dang por he ru ka'i phan yon dang nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas bya ba ni/

yang na phyag rnams sngon du byas de nas sdom bzung byas kyang chog go ḍā ki ni la sogs pa'i sar bhai ro tsa na badz+ra sa ta/ rat+na sa bha bā a mi de ba/ a mo ka si ti/ zhes bcug pas dkyil 'khor cho ga gzhan du gar gyi sngon 'gro nyan no// rdo rje mgo thog tu bzhag la/ deng khyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ ngas khyod la dpal he ru ka'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mdun du smra bar mi bya ste dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ yang rdo rje snying khar bzung la/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyis/ snying la yang dag zhugs pa yin// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te bshags// zhes brjod la don bshad de 'dir zhugs pas gsang ste bsgrubs na yon tan thams cad 'byung la/ ma gsang na snying dral te gshags pas myur du ma rungs par 'gyur bas de bas dam tshig dang ldan par bya'o// de nas dam tshig gi phud thod pa'am/ dung chos su sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs nas byin te/ 'di ni khyod dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'thob// oṃ pañtsa a mri ta ud gha ta tha thā hūm̐/ zhes so// de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dam tshig brjod par bya ste/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyi/ gang ngas 'di gyis shig ces bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya'o/ khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig khyod mi bde ba ma spangs par dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung par gyur ro// zhes brjod do// de rnams ni nang du 'jug pa'o// de nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa ni/

gsol ba gdab par byas te me tog phul la/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la/ dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab par mdzod cig ces brjod cing ting nge 'dzin rang nyid he ru kar bsgoms nas/ rkang zhabs su rlung*/ sum mdor me/ lte bar chu/ snying kha sa te lus 'byung ba'i rang bzhin snying khar hūm̐ de las 'od byung ste/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad dang 'dzam bu'i gling na dngos su bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad bkug ste rang gi lus la gzhug cing*/ lus thams cad 'od zer gyis ltems kyis gang bar bsgoms te/ bdud rtsi lnga dang byi la nag po'i brun dang*/ gu gul sbyar ba'i spos kyis bdug cing*/ yab yum gyi sngags la/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭa ma ha kro ta a be sha ya hūm̐/ oṃ shri he ru ka ya bhid/ ma he bhi ta ra tsa dza yā dhi ma he swāhā/ zhes brjod la rol mo dkrol cing dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams dbab par bya'o// sku gsung thugs la babs pa'i rtags rnams byung ba dang mnyam par bzhag par bya'o// ring du 'phar ba byung na rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ tiṣ+ṭa badz+ra zhes brtan par bya'o// de nas snang ba brtag cing me tog dor ba dang*/ mig dbye bar bya ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs snang bar byas te/ mig la ji ltar snang zhes dri/ dkar ser dmar ljang khra bo nag po rnams/ zhi rgyas dbang dang las thams cad pa drag po rnams 'grub ces bshad la/ me tog lag tu thogs nas/ slob dpon gyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// he ru ka dpal pho brang mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di nyid du/ bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi// lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dag bsod nams 'jig rten de ltar shog /'di'i dngos grub gang grub dang*// rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur// 'di yi bsod nams ci yod las/ dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /ces brjod nas/

slob mas pra ti ts+tsha badz+ra ho zhes brjod la dor ro// lha'i gnas pas ring du song na lan gsum gyi bar du dor te/ de nas kyang lha'i gnas su ma lhung na dngos grub med do// de nas spyan dbye ba/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson bar mdzod// phye bas thams cad mthong par 'gyur// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ oṃ badz+ra ni tra a pa hā ra pa ta lam̐ hri/ zhes brjod la spyan dar rdo rje dang bcas pa dbye'o// de nas dkyil 'khor bstan te/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs// 'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dang*// dngos grub kun khyod mngon du gyur// dam tshig thams cad bsrung ba dang*// gsang sngags la yang brtson par gyis// zhes bya ba dang*/ gzhan yang rgyas par byed na/ sna tshogs pad ma'i lte bar bzhugs// gnyis med gnyis min pang na gnas// brtan g.yo kun gyi bdag nyid can// spyod dang grol ba rab rtsol ba// kun mkhyen kun mdzad gtso bo ste// dpa' bo che la bu khyod ltos// rnal 'byor ma la sogs pa'i tshogs// grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma lnga po/ thod pa'i dum bu la sogs kun// 'khor lo mkha' la spyod pas bskor// rab tu gtum sogs yang dag 'khyud// gnyis po thugs kyi sprul pa yin// sdug gu can la sogs pa kun// rnal 'byor ma brgyad gnyis su med// gsung gi rnam dag ngo bo yis// mi yi 'jig rten dag tu khyab// stobs po che sogs pang gnas pa// grub pa sa 'og gnas pa yin// sku yi sprul par bshad pa ste// chags pa kun gyis rjes su chags// he ru ka dpal la sogs 'khor// g.yon nas 'khyud cing nu ma 'dzin// khwa la sogs pa brgyad po ni// khro bo rnam par rgyal sogs brgyad// bzhi po mchod pa bzhi yin te// byang chub phyogs chos ldan pa yin// brgyad gnyis mchod pa'i lha mo yis// lha rnams de nyid mtshan pa yin// zhes bshad do// de nas dbang bskur ba ni/

gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ bum dbang bdun dang*/ gong ma gsum dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon rjes gnang dang bcas pa'o// dang po ni phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul lo// he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob phyir gzi brjid can// ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas rtsal// de bzhin bdag la deng stsol cig /dpa' bo chen pos mi ldog pa'i// dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon 'gyur/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas/ de nas me tog chu'i dbang bskur dang*/ cod pan rdo rje dril bu dang ming dang sngags dang brtul shugs dang*/ zhes bdun yod pa las/ dang po ni snga ma lhung ba'i me tog de lha de nyid du bsams nas mgor bzhag nas/ pra ti gh+ri na i mam̐ bha ling ma ha swā hā zhes brjod do// de nas rnam rgyal bum pa blangs te/ slob ma'ang he ru kar mos su bcug nas/ slob dpon gyis shri he ru ka la sogs pa lha mo'i tshogs dang bcas pas dbang bskur bar mos pa byas la/ slob ma'i mgor bzhag cing khrus bya'o// ngag tu/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyis gsang gsum gyis// gnas las byung ba sbyin bar bya// ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// zhes pa dang*/ phun sum tshogs pa la sogs pas bkra shis brjod cing*/ yab yum gyi sngags dang*/ oṃ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣin tsa tu maṃ/ a bhi ṣe ka to sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur ro// de nas lus rnam par dag cing*/ mi bskyod pa'i rgyas gdab po// de nas dbu rgyan cod pan dang bcas pa rin chen 'byung ldan bde mchog dkyil 'khor du dmigs nas dziṃ gis byin gyis brlabs te mchod la/ slob ma yang de nyid du mos pa la bskon nas/

thor tshugs cod pan gyis brgyan pa// sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi// rin chen dag gis dbu rgyan dang*// dar dpyangs dbang bskur byin par bya// oṃ shri rat+na he he zhes pa dang*/ sarba bhu dha'i sngags brjod la// dbang bskur rdo rje nyi ma'i rang bzhin nga rgyal dag pa mnyam pa nyid kyi rgyas gdab bo /de nas dam tshig gi rdo rje a las 'od dpag med bde mchog he ru kar byin gyis brlabs la/ slob ma yang de nyid du dmigs te lag tu byin la/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur bas// de ring khyod la dbang bskur te /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rab tu bsgrubs phyir rdo rje long*// oṃ shri pad ma he he zhes yab yum gyi sngags dang bcas pas dbang bskur te/ 'dod chags dag cing so sor rtog pa'i rang bzhin pad ma gar dbang gi rgyas gdab po// de nas dam tshig gi dril bu la kham̐ las bde mchog he ru ka byin gyis brlabs la/ slob ma yang de nyid du dmigs la/ lag pa g.yon du gtad de/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ oṃ shrī karma he he yab yum gyi sngags kyis dbang bskur la/ phrag dog dag pa bya ba grub pa'i rang bzhin rta mchog gi rgyas gdab bo// de nas rdo rje dril bu 'khyud pa'i tshul du byin te/ oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad he ru kar slob ma yang mos shing ming gi dbang byin par bsams nas/ rdo rje dril bu yang dag 'khyud// g.yon snyems ma dang sgros 'dzin pa// gnyis med gnyis min rnal 'byor bdag /phyag rgya chen po'i byin gyis brlabs/ shri bhud dha he ru ka/ zhes bya ba dang*/ oṃ shri he ru ka a bhi ṣin tsa mam̐/ na ma a bhe ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal zhe sdang rdo rje zhes bya ba la sogs pa rigs gang la me tog lhung ba'i ming gi dbang byin nas/

gti mug dag pa chos dbyings ye shes kyi rang bzhin rnam par snang mdzad kyis rgyas gdab po// de la ming ni gtso bo'i/ rab tu dga' ba'i rdo rje/ bde chen rdo rje/ mchog gi rdo rje/ lhan cig skyes pa'i rdo rje zhes bya'o// bde chen 'khor lo/ ser sna rdo rje/ rin chen rdo rje/ gzi brjid rdo rje'o// thugs kyi bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ mi bskyod rdo rje/ zhe sdang rdo rje'o// gsung gi dpag med rdo rje/ dga' ba'i rdo rje/ 'dod chags rdo rje/ sku'i/ snang mdzad rdo rje/ gti mug rdo rje/ rtag pa'i rdo rje'o// sgo mtshams kyi/ rta mchog rdo rje/ phrag dog rdo rje las kyi rdo rje/ bud med la rdo rje shugs ma/ rdo rje phreng ba ma/ rdo rje ma ma ki/ rdo rje gos dkar mo/ rdo rje spyan ma/ rdo rje las byed ma zhes rim pas so// ming du ma rgyud las gsungs te/ 'dir ma bris so// rig pa'i dbang lnga po des sbyang gzhi nyon mongs lnga sbyangs nas/ ye shes lnga'i ngo bo he ru ka lnga bsgom pa'i skal ba can du 'gyur ro// gzhan yang tha mal gyi rtog pa sbyong bar byed pa'o// de nas sngags kyi dbang sbyin te/ phreng ba lag tu gtad la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// rtsa ba'i rig pa yang dag ldan// nyi shu rtsa gnyis sngags kyis ni// snying po'i dbang bskur sbyin par bya// zhes rtsa ba'i sngags kyi rjes gnang sbyin no// de nas rdo rje'i brtul shugs gnyis te dang po rdo rje'i brtul shugs ni rdo rje lag tu byin la/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// he ru ka dpal phyag na bsnams// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// he ru ka dpal brtul shugs brtan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta si dha badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭa e shang tra dha ra ya mi hūm̐ ha ha ha ho hi zhes so// de nas slob ma rigs drug pa bde mchog tu byas pas/ spyod pa'i brtul shugs sbyin te/ kha ṭ+wām̐ ga dang ḍa ma ru dang gri gug dang thod pa lag tu byin tshangs skud kyis brgyan la/

he ru ka dpal kha ṭ+wām̐ ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍa ma ru// rdo rje kha ṭ+wām̐ rdo rjer bcas/ dril bu sil sil sgra sgrogs shing*// tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag /kha ṭ+wām̐ ga dang rnal 'byor snod// dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis// zhes brjod do// dbang bdun no// gal te dbang gong ma dang rdo rje slob dpon du mi byed na 'di la lung bstan pa dang rjes gnang bcu gsum po btags la bya'o// de nas dbang gong ma bskur nas/ gsang dang phyag rgya gtad pa ste// zhes byung bas/ dang por gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis lus kyi dkyil 'khor gsal bar bsgrubs te/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ni// nang du yang dag gnas pa ste// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yi gnas// dkyil 'khor la ni bu khyod ltos// zhes bya bas spros pa la dga' na lus kyi dkyil 'khor bstan la me tog dor zhing maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas gsol ba gdab pa/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// ji ltar che ba'i che sbyin ltar// bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag brtsol// zhes lan gsum du brjod do// de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis rang nyid he ru ka yab yum gsal bar dmigs te/ mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs nas gnyis su med pa'i sbyor bas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad bkug cing byang chub kyi sems su gyur pa/ oṃ na ma sarba ta tha ga ta a nu ra ga ta badz+ra sa bha wa ad ma ko ham̐/ zhes mkha' gsang nas byung bar byas te/ dngos su reg rdo rje la sogs ma yin no// thod par bdud rtsi lnga sbyar ba lce la bzhag ste/ 'di ni dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i// dam tshig rmad byung chen po ste// khams lnga bcud kyi bdag nyid can// yang dag bde ba myang bar gyis// zhes/ slob mas/ a ho ma ha su kha ho/ zhes brjod nas btung ngo/rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dpa' bo// gnyis med ye shes sems ldan pa// dpa' bo las byung byang chub sems// rgyun gyis dbang ni bskur bar bya// zhes so// 'di'i dam tshig rjes su gnang ba ni dbang bzhi ka dus cig tu ston par 'gyur ro// gsang ba'i dbang ngo*// de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/

shin tu gsal ba'i sa phyogs ni// me tog ldan zhing shin tu bslabs// zhes pas sngags dang zhing dang yid skyes kyi phyag rgya gang yang la rung ste/ dang po zhugs pa'i dge slong dang rgan po la sogs pa rnams la ni ting nge 'dzin gyis bya'o// gzhan du na nyes par 'gyur bar dang po'i sangs rgyas kyis rgyud du gsungs so// de nas maṇ+ḍal dang mchod pa phul la gsol ba gdab pa/ sngar gyi byang chub rdo rje'am yang na/ skyabs med skyob pa skyobs med skyabs// 'khor lo sdom pa bdag la skyobs// rgyu med par ni thugs rje che// mgon med mgon bdag bka' drin rtsol// bdag nyid gtso khyod ci lta bar// gtso bos bdag kyang der 'drar mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ bying ba bdag la skyabs mdzod cig /ces lan gsum mo// de nas bla ma'i thugs ka nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma byung ste dri ba brjod pa ni/ bram ze rgyal rigs rje rigs dang*// dmangs rigs mtha' gnas bud med kun// gus dang bcas pas mchod pa dang*// gnyis med tshul gyis rab sbyor bar// dpa' bo khyod ni spro gyur ltam// smros cig dpa' bo bde ba che// zhes dris pa'i lan du slob mas brjod pa/ ci ltar gsungs pa'i dam tshig kun// bdag gis legs par brten par bgyi// zhes so/ de nas sngags skyes ni lag pa'am ting nge 'dzin ni rdo rje rnal 'byor ma snying khar bstims te sin dhu ra'i thig le byas nas brjod pa/ phyag rgya bzang mo 'di nyid ni// brten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs// bram ze rgyal rigs rje rigs dang*// dmangs rigs mthar skyes mkha' 'gro kun// bha ga pad mar tsum bha na'i// bdud rtsi lnga rnams bsgrub par bya// deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyis// brtul zhugs bzang pos 'gro don gyis// zhes brjod nas sbyin no// de la dbang gsum pa'i don ni 'di yin te/ phyi rol gyi phyag rgya ni mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa lnga ste/

bram ze mo la sogs pa'i ming gis btags pa yin no// nang du spyi bo ni bram ze mo ste de bzhin du 'khor lo lnga yin no// de nas sngags dang yid kyi rdo rje phag mo'am gang yang rung ste/ rang gi spyi bor ham̐/ mgrin par oṃ/ snying khar hūm̐/ lte bar a bsgoms nas/ a las ye shes kyi me spar nas yi ge rnams bsregs shing haṃ la bdud rtsi'i rgyud byung bas/ dga' ba bzhi rab tu brtan pa ni sems bde stong gnyis med du bzhag ste snang ba thams cad la rgyas gdab po// de yang dpyid thig las/ gzhom med ham̐ gi sa bon ni// ba mo lta bu 'dzag pa nyid// lus can rnams kyi snying dga' ba// 'di ni dpyid ces bya bar bshad// rgod ma'i me 'dra'i ngo bo ni// phag mo thig ler brjod pa ste// las kyi rlung gis bskul ba yis// lte ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid du 'bar// dpyid thob nas ni legs tshim zhing*// snyoms par 'jug pa yang dag gnas// 'di dag khrag 'thung dpal yin te// dpyid dang thig le nyid du brjod// zhes gsungs pa'i don bsgoms par bya'o// gzhan yang mgrin pa'i rlabs kyi rtsa btsir na'ang brdar 'gyur te/ longs spyod kyi ni rlabs nyid kyi// rang gi g.yas dang lag gzhan gyi// mthe bong dang ni srin lag gis// de ni rnal 'byor pa yis btsir// de las ye shes skye bar 'gyur// de las ci zhig skye zhe na// gzhon nu'i dga' ba ji lta'am// lkugs pa'i rmi lam ci lta bar// mchog gi mtha' dang dga' bral dbus// stong pa stong min he ru ka /zhes gsungs so// rjes gnang 'og nas ston par 'gyur ro// dbang gsum pa'o// de nas dbang bzhi pa sbyin par bya'o// de la gzhung 'dir bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no// zhes gsungs pas gsum pa nyid kyi lhan skyes bzhi par bzhed do snyam du kha cig bsam par 'gyur te/ de lta na 'dir tsar+ya pa nyid kyis dpyid thig dang gsang chen dang rim bzhir bstan pa don med par 'gyur ro// des na bzhi pa bla ma'i zhal la ltos pa 'dir mdo tsam brjod do// maṇ+ḍal phul la/

sgrib pa ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// he ru ka dpal bde chen po// shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid can// rdo rje sems dpa' mi 'gyur ba/ phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes kyi// dbang bskur bdag la bstsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod cing de nas bla mas bstan par bya ste/ de yang bcom ldan 'das kyis rtsa'i rgyud chen por/ las kyi phyag rgya yongs su spangs// ye shes phyag rgya rnams rtags dor// mchog tu mi 'gyur rnal 'byor pas// phyag rgya chen po bsgoms par bya// zhes gsungs pas/ de'i don dpyid thig nas gsungs pa/ rnam mi rtog pas sangs rgyas min// rnam rtog bcas la de bzhin min// shin tu rnam dag yongs shes pas// mkhas pa rnams su 'gyur ba nyid// rang bzhin gyis ni bya bas yod// byed pa po yi rang bzhin te// bya dang byed pa'i dngos po ni// rang bzhin bdag ni yongs su spangs// bye ba kun gyi rang bzhin ni// yi ge a la rnam par gnas// thog mtha' med pa'i ngo bo nas// rin chen rnams kyi rgya mtsho bzhin// zhes byung bas/ snang ba gzhal yas kyi khang pa phung po khams dang skye mched lha dang lha mo/ rlung rdo rje'i bzlas pa de thams cad kyang rang gi sems skye ba med cing 'gag pa med pa sems rang bzhin dag pa he ru ka yul chos su snang ba rdo rje phag mo/ snang ba dang stong pa dbyer med pa gang gis rtogs pa ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dbang bskur ba'o// de nas rgyun du bde ba dang stong pa gnyis su med pa'i don bsgom par bya'o// gang du mchog dang khyod dga' gnyis mthong ba// dbus der chos kyi yi ge mtshon par gyis// 'di lta'i man ngag gal te bsgrub pa na// de'i khyim bdag mo rlung mi g.yo 'ching*/ zhes nag po pas gsungs so// dbang bzhi pa rgyas par ni rdzogs rims de dag nas gsungs so// bzhi pa'o// de ltar dbang de rnams kyis ngag dang yid dag par byed pa rtsa rlung thig le dang phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'o// da ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang brjod do// kha cig rdo rje slob dpon bum ba'i dbang yin no// zhes 'dod pa ni 'khrul pa ste/

ji ltar dbang gong ma gsum ma rdzogs shing rgyus med par slob dpon du ci skad bya/ yang na ni dbang bzhi po re re la rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang re re bya dgos so// 'di dag ni nges pa mang du yod mod kyi spros pa bzhag go /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rjes su 'brengs so// de nas gang rdo rje slob dpon 'dod pa de la khri stegs pad ma'i gdan bya zhing steng du gdugs dang ldan pa bya ste/ 'di nyid nas/ pad ma 'dab brgyad steng du ni// seng ge'i khri sogs la bzhag ste// slob ma gnyis med sbyor ldan pas// dkyil 'khor lus nang chud par bya// phyag rgya lnga sogs ma lusapa// he ru ka dpal bdag nyid sprul// spyod dang brtul zhugs bstan pa dang*// de bzhin gnyis med tshangs spyod bstan// steng du gdugs dkar bzung nas ni// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kyis// bkra shis sgra yis gang ba yi/ zhes byung bas so// de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ gang gis bdag ni khyod drin las// rang dang gzhan don nus gyur pa// rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang*// thugs rje'i gter bkye bdag la stsol// zhes lan gsum mo// de nas khri la bzhag ste/ bum pa'i chus bkra shis dang bcas pas bkru zhing*/ oṃ rad na mu gu tram̐ a bhi ṣin tsa ya mi zhes dbu rgyan bskon la/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /ces brjod pas rdo rje byin la badz+ra sa twa hūm̐ zhes/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi dam tshig bzung bar bya'o// de nas/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni// srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur// ces dril bu byin la/ dharma dhar tu aḥ oṃ shri he ru ka a ti pa ta tram̐ a bhi ṣin tsa mi ti nya bhi ra sa ma ya stam̐/

zhes chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong 'dzin pa'i blo dkrol du gzhug ste/ gsung gi dam tshig go /yid kyi lus ni bstan bya'i phyir// phyag rgya'i dam tshig zhes su brjod// dam tshig yid ni brtan pa gang*// des na phyag rgyar rab tu grags// zhes sku'i sgo nas sems can thams cad kyi don byas te sku'i dam tshig go /rdo rje rab mchog rdo rje ni// che dang dril bu chen po zung*// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma bsdu ba nyid du gyis// de ring khyod kyis dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgo nas sems can thams cad smin par bya zhing dbang bskur ba dang rgyud bshad pa dang las dang ye shes ma lus pa bsgrubs shig de ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang dngos gzhi'o// de nas rjes gnang ni/ rus rgyan rigs lnga'i rjes gnang dang*// gar dang phreng ba glu dang dri// spos dang mar me thur ma dang*// me long dung dang 'phrin las bzhi// grub pa brgyad dang dam tshig kun// rjes gnang bcu gsum dam tshig bcas// lung bstan dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod dang*// 'dir ni bcu bdun bshad pa yin// dang po sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rus rgyan gtad la/ 'khor lo thod pa rna rgyan dang*// mgul rgyan gdub bu ske rags dang*// do shal dang ni rnam pa bdun// phyag rgya yis ni dbang bskur ro// brgyan no// 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// bya ba spyod tshul gsang ba yi// chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor// de la rdo rje'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ rin chen 'khor lo rab tu bskor// pad ma'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor// las kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor// zhes 'don pa bsgyur te bya'o// de nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas// rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' tshogs dang*// shes rab thabs kyi snyems chen gyis// gnang mchog bde ba'i dga' ston gyis// gar ro// sgegs dang bcas pas 'phreng ba 'chang*// sangs rgyas kun sogs rnal 'byor ma// de ni 'bral bar mi 'gyur te// 'phreng ba 'di ni brgyan yin no// phreng ba'o// lus can rnams la dam chos kyi// khyod kyis glu ni blang bar bya// de nas rnal 'byor ma de dang*// myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur// glu'o// khyod kyis rgyal la dri phul la// tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang*// rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yi// byang chub lus can rnams la gos// dri'o// rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul la// brtul zhugs bzang pos legs tshim gyis// lus can bde gshegs ma lus su// ye shes kyis ni tshim par 'gyur// spos so// chos kyi mar me legs sbar ba// pad ma gar dbang bdag nyid de// sems can ma rig mdong

sa byas pa// ye shes sgron mas snang bar gyis// mar me'o// ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar// bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i// rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal// oṃ badz+ra ne tra ma a pa ha ra pa ta lam̐ hri/ thur ma'o// chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun du byung*// ngo bo med cing gnas med par// de ltar chos 'di shes kyis la// sems can don ni mnyam med don// 'on tam rnal 'byor ma sras skyes// me long ngo*// khyod kyi the tshom dogs med par// yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis ni// chos kyi dung ni bla med par// dri med kun du gang bar gyis// dung ngo*// zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /gdang bar bya dang gnod sogs dang*// bsod nams bskrad pa thams cad de// las de rnams ni grub par gyis// 'phrin las so// ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang*// mchil lham mi snang ri lu ste// gnod sbyin ma yi dngos grub kun// de ni ci dgar grub par gyis// grub pa brgyad kyi rjes gnang ste// bcu gsum mo// de nas dam tshig gi rjes gnang sbyin par bya ba/ nang par sngar langs sems bdag nyid// ma lus lus la byas nas kyang*// bsrung dang bza' ba la sogs pa'i// gdol pa'i bdag nyid can bsrung ngo*// lus dang srog la ltos med par// dam tshig dang ni sdom pa bsrung*// nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// nyin re bzhin ni bslab par bya// gang tshe nyams na rnal 'byor pa// kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur// dgun zla 'bring sogs nas brtsams te// zla ba re re bsrung ba ni// gnyis med gnyis med 'khor lor gnas// tshes bcu la ni de rab mchog /chang dang sha sogs gang ci rung*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs// thams cad gnyis med sa na gnas// he ru ka dpal rab tu mchog

/theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya// sems can la yang rgyab mi phyogs// 'khor ba dag kyang mi spang zhing*// mya ngan 'das la dgar mi 'gro// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun la// khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya ste// phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang*// mtshan ma 'gong bar mi bya'o// dam tshig rab bsrungs bsod nams kyis// tshe 'di nyid la grub par 'gyur// mkha' 'gro thams cad mthong ba na// g.yon nas lan gsum bskor bya zhing*// spyi bos phyag ni byas nas kyang*// lan gsum bar du gsol ba gdab// bdag gi ma khyod bu yin te// ji srid byang chub 'byung bar du// byang chub yan lag nu ma las// byung ba'i rang gi 'o mas skyongs// gnyis med ye shes spyod ldan pa'i// bslab pa blangs ba sngon 'gro bas// sgra stong la sogs sngon 'gro ba'i// tshangs par spyod pa shin tu bsrungs// dam tshig de la rtags gnas te// bskyed rims sngon 'gro sbas pa'i yid// spyod dang grol ba'i gnas 'dod pa/ yid la 'dod pa kun grub 'byung*// zhes bya ba bum dbang dang 'brel ba'i dam tshig rgyas pa'o// gnyis med ye shes sems ldan la// mi bya ba ni ci yang med// tshangs par spyod pa rtag mnos la// 'dod pa lnga ni spyad par gyis// gnyis med la gnas zas la ni// rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs 'da'// gnyis med pa dang dgos pa med// dam tshig spyod pa'i spyod pa bya// zhes bya ba ni gsang ba'i dang 'brel ba'i dam tshig go /sna tshogs dbang phyug legs spyad cing*// tshangs par spyod pa de bzhin no// khro ba med pa'i rgyun spyad pa// bsgrub pa pos ni yongs su bsrung*// rtag tu bsgrub la gnas nas ni// yul kun la ni rnam rol cing*// gnyis med grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma// mi brtan srog ni ji srid par// bu khyod kyis ni bsgrub par bya// 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la// ci dga' bar ni longs spyod cig

/ces bya ba ni shes rab ye shes dang 'brel ba'i dam tshig go /he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor cher// bsams nas thams cad rab tu brtag /bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// rnal 'byor ma ni kun gyi gnas// de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis// he ru ka dpal bdag mchod do// 'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi// khams gsum na ni sdig med pas// de bas 'dod la chags bral bar// khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o// zhes bya ba ni bzhi pa dang 'brel ba'i dam tshig yin no// dam tshig 'di rnams dbang yongs su rdzogs pa'i slob ma la bstan par bya'o// de nas bla mas lung bstan pa ni/ chos gos bgos pa seng ge'i rna ba ltar byas te don yod grub pa'i phyag rgya bcas nas mi 'jig pa byin te/ slob ma'i mgo bor reg nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyis lung bstan par mos te/ oṃ 'di ltar nga yis lung bstan te// he ru ka dpal de bzhin gshegs// dngos po mchog tu bsgrub bya'i phyir// srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton// shri he ru ka na ma sarba ta thā ga ta si ti sa ma ya stam̐/ bhur bhu bā swa/ zhes bya ba ni lung bstan pa ste/ sngar gyi gsang mtshan dang 'brel ba'i de bzhin gshegs par ma 'ongs pa na 'gyur ro// zhes gzengs bstod par 'gyur te de'i bum pa'i dbang gi ming dang rjes su 'brel ba yin no// de nas bla mas dbugs dbyung bar bya ste/ khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che// rgyal po bdag por bstan pa dang*// der ni bdud las rnam rgyal zhing*// grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin// deng ni sangs rgyas nyid thob par// khyed rnams the tshom med pa yin// dbang ni bskur ba tsam gyis ni// slob ma yon tan bdag por 'gyur// slob dpon nyid kyis bde ba yis// brtan g.yo kun gyis dam tshig yin// dbugs dbyung pa ste gsang dang 'brel to// zhes bzhed do// ces shes rab ye shes la ni/ a li ka li'i rigs kyi khyad par ngos gzung ste spyod pa'i brtul shugs kyi phyag rgya lung bstan no zhes grags so// dbang bskur ba ma lus pa'o// de nas ji skad bshad pa yi// cho gas sbyin bsreg las bya zhing*// rnal 'byor ma la gtor ma sbyin// mkha' 'gro ma ni mchog 'grub 'gyur// zhes byung bas tshogs dang gtor ma dang*/

nang gi sbyin bsreg gam phyi rol gyi mchod pa la sogs bya zhing bla ma mchod par bya'o// de yang*/ dmangs rigs stong phrag gnyis dag kyang*// bram ze gtsang ma gnyis dang 'dra// bram ze stong phrag gnyis dag ni// dge slong cig la rab tu sbyar// dge slong stong phrag gnyis dag ni// rdul med pa ni cig dang mnyam// rdul med stong phrag gnyis dag ni// ye shes ldan pa cig la sbyar// ye shes ldan pa stong phrag gnyis// bla ma cig dang mnyam par brtag /de ltar sbyin pa'i zhing byas nas// glang po rta dang shing rta nor/ nor bu byi ru mu tig sogs// yon gyi mchog ni ji snyed pa/phyag byas nas ni dbul bar bya// deng nas brtsams te bran du bdag /khyed la bdag ni 'bul ba lags// rang gi slob mar gyur pa dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// zhes so// de nas sang nyin tshon rnams dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol nas badz+ra mus shar nas dbus kyi bar du phyin la/ ci bde bar bsdus te gser la sogs pa'i bum par bsdus la/ chu bo la gshegs su gsol bar bya'o// slar yang dga' ston bya'o// dpal spyod pa'i brtul shugs can la he ru ka nyid kyis lung bstan nas/ gzhung drug mdzad pa las/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyud rnams sdebs pas shin tu sbram pa la phal gyis rdzogs pa'i phyag len mi pher bar 'dug pas/ bdag pas dman pa rnams la phan par bsams nas// dkyil 'khor shin tu gsal bar byed pa rang byung rol pa'i rdo rje yis bde chen du sbyar ba rdzogs so// dkyil 'khor mngon par snang ba la// 'gal dang nor pa byung srid na// mkha' 'gro rnams kyis bzod par mdzod// dge bas dpal he ru kar gyur cig /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /dge legs 'phel lo// ༈ //'khor lo sdom pa'i mngon rtogs lha bcu gsum ma bzhugs so// na mo ma hā gu ru bh+ya/ kun du brtags pa spangs pa'i mchog

/bde ba chen po mdzes pa'i dpal// sa rnams kun du phan mdzad pa// rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal// de la 'dir re shig dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha bcu gsum pa'i nang gi rnal 'byor la brtson par 'dod pa'i sngags pa dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig la gnas pas/ nang par snga bar langs te/ dam tshig brtan par byas la he ru ka zhes brjod pas/ bdag nyid kyi lus zhal cig phyag gnyis pa'i bcom ldan 'das sku mdog mthing kha/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ ngag sngags kyi rang bzhin rnam par dag pa dang bcas pa bskyed la/ phyi rol dang lag pa'i mchod pa sngon du 'gro bas sam/ yang na rang gi snying khar yi ge hūm̐ bsams pa'i 'od zer gyis 'phreng bas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo/ dur khrod/ rdo rje/ me ri dang bcas pa/ shar phyogs dbang po'i dur khrod du bla ma rje btsun rdo rje sems dpa' ltar bzhugs pa gsal bar bltas la/ yid kyis phyag 'tshal zhing*/ mchod pa'i lha mo'i tshogs spros nas mchod par byas te/ oṃ a badz+ra bha na hūṃ/ oṃ a badz+ra bam̐ se hūm̐/ oṃ a badz+ra mu ran dze hūm̐/ oṃ a badz+ra mu kun dhe hūm̐/ oṃ a badz+ra ha se hūm̐/ oṃ a badz+ra la se hūm̐/ oṃ a badz+ra ghir ti hūm̐/ oṃ a badz+ra nir ti hūm̐/ oṃ a badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ oṃ a badz+ra dhu pe hūm̐/ oṃ a badz+ra ḍi pe hūm̐/ oṃ a badz+ra ghan dhe hūm̐/ oṃ a badz+ra dhar she hūm̐/ oṃ a badz+ra ra se hūm̐/ oṃ a badz+ra par she hūm̐/ oṃ a badz+ra dhar me hūm̐/ zhes pas pi wang ma sngon mo/ gling bu ma ser mo/ rnga zlum ma dmar mo/ rdza rnga ma ljang khu/ bzhad ma dmar mo/ sgeg ma sngon mo/ glu ma ser mo/ gar ma ljang khu/ me tog ma ser mo/ bdug spos ma dud kha/ mar me ma dmar ser/ dri chab ma ljang khu/ gzugs rdo rje dkar mo/ ro rdo rje dmar mo/ reg rdo rje ljang khu/ chos dbyings rdo rje dkar mo/ rang rang gi mchod pa'i brgyan 'dzin pa rnams kyis mchod la/

gzhan mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ lā ma dang*/ dum skyes ma dang*/ gzugs can ma rnams kyis sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga thogs pas mchod nas/ de'i drung du sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa bya ste/ byas dang byed du bcug dang yid rang ba'i sdig pa ma lus pa'i skyon kun 'jig byed pa'i/ spyan sngar so sor bshags shing slar yang ni// mi bgyid pa'i sdom pa blang bar bgyid// nyan thos rang rgyal bla med rgyal ba dang*// rgyal ba'i sras pos bsags pa'i dge ba gang*// de dag la ni rjes su yid rang zhing*// byang chub tu ni yang dag bdag bsngo'o// rgyal ba dkon mchog gsum po la sogs la// dngos po kun nas bdag ni skyabs su mchi// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de bzhin du// bla na med pa'i lam la brten par bgyi// de'i rjes la byams pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ btang snyoms te tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom mo// de nas rang nyid mi gnas pa'i bdag nyid du/ skad cig gis stong pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas par bya'o// oṃ swa bha ba shud dho sarba dharma swa bha ba shud dho ham̐/ oṃ shu n+ya ta dzña na badz+ra swa bha ba ad ma ko haṃ/ zhes bya bas gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i dngos po thams cad bsdus te rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin du gnas par bya'o// de nas ting nge 'dzin las langs nas/ na da'i gzugs kyis gnas pa la 'gro ba thams cad sgyu ma lta bur bltas la/ 'og gi phyogs su yam̐ yongs su gyur pa las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs can sngon po/ ram̐ yongs su gyur pa las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po/ bam̐ yongs su gyur pa las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkar po/ lam̐ yongs su gyur pa las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa ser po/ de'i steng du suṃ las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi'i rang bzhin can no// de nas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ni/ ri rab kyi steng du 'od zer las byung ba'i yi ge hūm̐ las rdo rje rgya gram/

shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ngo*// dbus kyi lte ba yangs shing rgya che ba las/ rdo rje sa gzhir byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ me de ni badz+ri bha ba bhan dha hūm̐/ de las 'od 'phros pas rdo rje'i ra ba gru bzhi pa/ oṃ badz+ra pra ka ra hūm̐ bam̐ hūṃ/ de'i nang du rdo rje rim pa lnga'i gyur/ oṃ badz+ra pan tsa hūm̐ yam̐ hūm̐/ de'i nang du rdo rje'i bla re/ oṃ badz+ra bhi na hūm̐ kham̐ hūm̐/ de'i phyi rol du rdo rje'i mda' yi ra ba/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dza la tram̐ sam̐ tram̐/ de'i phyi rol du ye shes kyi me dpung gis mtshams bcing bar bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra dza la a na la kam̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes bya bas byin gyis brlab cing rgyas gdab par bya'o// de ltar sngon du 'gro ba rdzogs nas/ rten dang brten pa bskyed pa ni/ bsrung pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i 'khyams la mtshan nyid thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i gzhal yas kyi khang pa/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ rta babs dang bcas pa/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba bsgom par bya'o// de'i nang du sna tshogs pad ma'i lte ba la/ a li las zla ba/ ka li las nyi ma/ kha sbyar ba'i dbus su na da zhugs pa las yi ge hūm̐ rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag nyid 'od zer lnga 'phros par bsgom mo// de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gsal bar bsgom par bya ste/ de la dbus kyi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa 'jigs byed dang*/ dus mtshan gyi dpral ba dang*/ nu ma g.yas brkyang bas mnan te bzhugs pa/ sku mdog sngon po dang*/ ljang khu dang*/ dmar po dang*/ ser pos te zhal bzhi pa can/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa/ thod pa lnga yis dbu la brgyan pa/ sku la mgo bo rlon pa'i phreng ba brgya phyed kyis brgyan pa/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor tshugs can/

mgul rgyan dang*/ snyan cha dang*/ gdub bu dang*/ ske rags dang*/ dbu'i nor bu dang mchod phyir thogs dang thal ba ste/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pas 'jigs par byed pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ sgeg pa/ dpa' ba/ 'jigs su rung pa/ rgod pa/ gshe ba/ 'jigs par byed pa/ snying rje ba/ rngam zhing*/ zhi ba'i gar dang ldan pa/ phyag bcu gnyis kyis spras pa ste/ yum rdo rje phag mo la 'khyud pa rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i lpags pa bsnams pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍa ma ru bsnams pa/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gug drug pa na rtse gsum/ g.yon gsum pa na kha ṭ+wām̐ ka bzhi pa na thod pa/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo 'dzin pa'o// de'i mdun du bcom ldan 'das ma/ skra grol ba sku mdog dmar mo/ spyan gsum ma/ zhal gcig ma/ gcer bu/ dum bu'i ske rags kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yon pa na thod pa khrag gis bkang ba 'khyud pa/ g.yas pa na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i sdig mdzub can/ byin pa gnyis bcom ldan 'das kyi brla la 'khril te bcugs pas 'khyud nas bzhugs par bsgom par bya'o// mdun gyi pad ma'i 'dab ma/ zla ba'i gdan la/ mkha' 'gro ma mthing kha/ g.yon du rab mdzes ma ljang khu/ rgyab tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ g.yas su gzugs can ma ser mo/ zhal gcig pa/ spyan gsum pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ skra grol ba/ rnam par mdzes ma/ kun gyi g.yas dang po na ḍa ma ru 'khrol ba/ 'og ma gri gug /g.yon dang po na kha ṭ+wām̐ ga /'og ma thod pa bsnams pa/ rus pa'i brgyan cha lngas brgyan cing thod pa sha dang bcas pa skam po'i phreng bas do shal byas pa/ g.yas brkyang pas zla ba la bzhugs pa'o// mtshams su rin po che'i bum pa bkang pa la ye shes kyi bcud kyis gang ba rnams kyis kha brgyan pa'o// phyi rol gyi pad ma'i 'dab ma ro'i gdan la/ shar du kha gdong ma mthing kha/

lhor phag gdong ma ser mo/ nub tu khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ byang du 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ shar lho mtshams su gshin rje sreg ma/ lho nub mtshams su gshin rje pho nya mo/ nub byang mtshams su gshin rje mche ba ma/ byang shar mtshams su gshin rje 'joms ma/ kun kyang zhal gcig pa/ spyan gsum pa/ skra grol ba/ thod pa skam pos dbu brgyan pa/ g.yas pa na ḍa ma ru dang gri gug g.yon pa na kha ṭ+wām̐ ga dang thod pa/ nam mkha'i gos can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ mtshams ma rnams ni gzugs gnyis ma'o// de nas lha thams cad kyi spyi bor 'khor lo la oṃ/ mgrin par pad ma la a/ snying khar rdo rje la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bkod nas bsgom par bya'o// de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi oṃ ha snying kha la/ na ma hi mgo la/ swā hā spyi gtsug la/ bho shad dhe phrag pa la/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho dpral ba/ phaṭa ham̐ yan lag thams cad la go chas bsrung bar bya'o// de nas bcom ldan 'das ma'i lte bar oṃ bam̐/ snying khar ham̐ yam̐/ kha la hriṃ mam̐/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ/ spyi bor hūm̐ hūm̐ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa kyi go kon par bya'o// de nas skye mched rnams la mig tu oṃ dkar po/ rna bar hūm̐ sngon po/ sna la tram̐ ser po/ lce la oṃ dmar po/ nor bu la kham̐ ljang khu/ yid kyi skye mched la tshogs khar ham̐ dkar po rnams bkod par bya'o// de nas snying kha'i sngags kyi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug par byas te/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcings la ngag tu pheṃ zhes brjod pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bkug ste/ dza hūm̐ bam̐ hos gnyis su med par gzhug go /de dang dus mtshungs pa nyid du/ snying kha'i sngags kyi 'od zer las byung ba'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba gtab pas/ rin po che'i bum pa 'dzin pa'i lha mo dag gis dbang bskur bar bya ste/

ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ba// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo// oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing dbang bskur bas/ chu lhag ma las byung ba'i rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das la ni rdo rje sems dpa'/ bcom ldan 'das ma la ni rnam par snang mdzad/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi la ni rin chen 'byung ldan/ sgo mtshams ma rnams la ni don yod grub pas dbu brgyan par bya'o// de nas snying kha'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyi rol gyi yul gzugs la sogs pa thams cad mchod pa'i lha mo'i gzugs su gyur te bdag la mchod par bsam mo/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i zhal nas bstod pa 'thon pa mngon du byas te/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor// khyod ni nyid kyi thugs las bde legs thob// der ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro rnams dag /snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad par mdzad// sgyu ma'i sprul pas don rnams grub par mdzad// mgon po bde chen dpal ldan dgyes par bzhengs// zhes bstod/ de nas dam tshig gi rdzas sam/ yang na yid kyi/ yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ kam̐ las thod pa'i sgyid po gsum gyi steng du/ a las byung ba'i thod pa'i nang du bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga/ steng du oṃ/ a las byung ba'i nang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi kha gcod kyi dbus su hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje ru bsgom ste/ oṃ a hūm̐ zhes brjod pas bdud rtsi zhu bar gyur te ye shes kyi bdud rtsi zhu ba dang gnyis su med par bya ste/ lha tshogs rnams kyi lce rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i rnam pas myang bar bya'o// de nas 'khor lo'i gnas sngags kyi phreng ba bkod la/ mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs te/ kha sbyor dbus na sa bon gnas// thig le gnyis pa mi 'gyur ba// rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo nyid// rnal 'byor pa yi rtag tu bsgom// zhes gsungs pa'i don la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag par bya'o// de las skyo bar gyur na bzlas pa'i man ngag ji lta ba bzhin du bzlas par bya'o// sngags ni 'di yin te/

de nas/ oṃ shri badz+ra he he ru ru kam̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ḍa ki ni dza la saṃ bha ra swāhā/ oṃ hri ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rje btsun gyi snying po dang*/ nye ba'i snying po'o// oṃ sarba bhud dha ḍa ki ni ye/ badz+ra wa ṇa ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bā+ai ro tsa ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lha mo'i snying po dang*/ oṃ ḍa ki ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ lā ma ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇa ḍa ro hi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ru pi ṇi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ka ka s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ lu ka s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sha na ka s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ su ka ra s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dha ti ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma du te ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dam̐ ṣ+ṭi ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma ma tha na ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dpa' bo rnams kyi sngags so// bsgom pa yis dub nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom par 'dod na/ a li dang ka li'i rang bzhin gyi 'od zer spros te/ brtan g.yo thams cad lha'i rang bzhin du gsal ba las/ bdag nyid kyi zhal du bsdus te/ lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' rnal 'byor ma dang bcas pa'i lha'i gzugs su yud tsam bsgoms nas/ bcom ldan 'das yab yum rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus te/ de nyid kyang gnyis su med par zhu ba las hūm̐ gi rnam pa/ de nyid kyang rims kyis bsdus te gong bu dang na da'i gzugs las rnam par 'das nas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rang bzhin du bsgom par bya'o// thun mtshams kyi gtor ma dang phyi rol gyi mchod pa la sogs pa ni mchod 'phreng du bstan zin to// bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha bcu gsum gyi mngon bar rtogs pa 'di ni/ grags pa rgyal mtshan la sogs pa rnams kyis bskul phyir bsdus pa la dga' ba rnams kyi don du/ byi ba lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes brgyad la/

yar lha sham po'i mgul du/ rang byung rdo rjes sbyar ba'o// mngon par rtogs pa rgyas pa la dga' ba rnams bla ma gnyan ras kyis mdzad pa la lta bar bya'o// dpal ldan gnyis med a ba dhu ti pa'i// mngon par rtogs pa gsal bar sdebs pa las// 'di la 'jug rnams rim gnyis don mthong zhing*// tshe gcig rdo rje 'chang gi sa thob shog /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog// / ༈ 'khor lo sdom pa'i mchod 'phreng bzhugs so// bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad dpal ldan he ru ka dpal gtso// 'od zer sngon po stong ldan nyi ma brgya yi gzi// rdo rje yan lag ma dang gnyis med rab sbyor bas// mchog mtha' dbu ma'i rang bzhin de la bdag phyag 'tshal// de la re shig dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnal 'byor la brtson pas/ phyi rol gyi mchod pa la sogs pa nang dang phyi rol gyi bdag nyid kyi mchod pa'i rim pa la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// thog mar gnas yid dang mthun par dus khyad par can la dkyil 'khor la dri dang chang dang bdud rtsi lngas byugs la/ chu gsum dang mchod pa dang gtor ma legs par bshams la/ de nas mchod pa'i rdzas rnams bdud rtsi lnga'i chu dang swa bha was bsangs la/ de'i rjes su mchod pa rnams dpag tu med par byin gyis brlab bo// zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis bgegs bsal bar byas te/ gtor ma byin nas bden pa'i tshig gis bgegs bskrad pa'i 'og tu/ sku'i 'od kyis steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad me lce 'bar ba rab tu mi bzad pa'i klong nas khro bo dpag tu med pas bgegs thams cad brlag par bsam zhing*/ hūm̐/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can// ma lus phyogs nas bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas thams cad bdag la gson// bdag ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin// bka' yi 'khor lo rab sbyor bas// lha dang lha min gsang ba'o// brjed byed la sogs bgegs kyi tshogs// sa 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du dengs// gal te bka' las 'das gyur na// rdo rje me ltar 'bar ba yis// klad pa tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing*// 'jig par 'gyur ba gdon mi za// zhes bya ba dang sum bha nis bgegs bskrad do// rdo rje ra ba la sogs pa drug bya zhing*/

kha gdong ma la sogs pa rnams kyis bgegs bcom ste phur bus gdab par bya'o// de ltar sngon du 'gro ba'o// dngos gzhi la gnyis te/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa dang*/ mchod pa'o// dang po ni dkyil 'khor dri dang chang gis byugs te/ lha lnga dang*/ bcu gsum pa dang*/ drug cu rtsa gnyis pa la sogs pa so so'i gzhung ltar tshom bu dgod pa sngon du 'gro bas/ bskyed chog gang rung gis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs par bskyed do// bdag nyid yan lag bdun dang sems bskyed pa sngon du 'gro bas lhar bskyed par bya'o// yang na sngon du tshom bu la sogs pa ma grub na bdag nyid bskyed pa dang dus mnyam du mdun du'ang lta'o// de dag la go cha sku gsung thugs byin gyi brlab pa'o// ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs pa ni/ hūm̐/ khyab bdag dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin can// gnas med 'gro 'ong bral ba nam mkha' bzhin// gshegs dang byon pa'i mtshan ma mi mnga' yang*// chu zla bzhin du gar dmigs der snang ba// bdud dpung 'joms mdzad dpal ldan he ru ka /bla ma yid dam mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas// bdag gis dad pas deng 'dir spyan 'dren na// dmigs med thugs rje'i dbang gis 'dir gsal mdzod// e a ra li zhes bya ba la sogs pas spyan drangs/ de nas/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams bskal par ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// zhes bzhugs su gsol zhing dza hūm̐ bam̐ hos gnyis su med par bya'o// de dag ni dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'o// gnyis pa mchod pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa dang*/ thun mong gi mchod pa'o// dang po ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shri tsakra sam̐ bha ra ma ḍa la sarba bhi ra yo gi ni argam̐ pra ti dza ye hūm̐/ zhes yon chab dang*/ de bzhin du ghan dhe zhes dri chab dang*/ pa t+yam̐ zhes zhabs bsil dbul bar bya'o// gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngags kyi mchod pa ni/
