oṃ na mo bha ga ba te wi re sha ya/ ma hā ka lpa ni san ni bha ya/ dza ḍa ma ku ḍod ka rā ya ḍam̐ ྴྟ ka ra lo gra bhi sha ṇa mu kha ya/ sra ha sra bhu dza bha su ra ya pa ra shu pa sho ḍa shu la kha ṭam̐ ga ḍa ri ni/ bh+ya gra dz+ri tsa ma ra dha ra ya/ ma hā dhu ma bra bhā ka ra wa pu sha ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa zhes bya ba dang*/ dpa' mo rnams kyi rang ming gi mthar hūm̐ phaṭa sbyar ba'i sngags dang*/ snying po dang nye ba'i snying po sbyar ba'i sngags dang*/ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ bhan dha bhan dha/ tra sa ya/ tra sa ya/ k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo bha ya/ hroṃ hroṃ/ hra hra/ pheṃ pheṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bha k+ṣa bha k+ṣa/ ba sa ru dha ri/ an+t+ra ma la/ ba lam̐ bhi ṇe/ gh+ri h+na gh+ri h+na/ sa bha la ga ta bhu dziṃ ga par pām̐ pa/ ta rdza ya ta rdza ya/ a ka dh+ya a ka dh+ya/ hriṃ hriṃ dzñā+oṃ dzñā+oṃ/ ྐྷཾ ྐྷཾ/ hāṃ hāṃ/ hīṃ hīṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ki li ki li/ si li si li/ hi li hi li/ dhi li dhi li/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ na mo bā ga wa te badz+ra bha ra hi bam̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo ar+ya a pa ra dzi te tre lo dha ma dha ma hā bir+ya sha re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo sarba bhudha bha ya bha he ma ha badz+re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra a pa ni a dzi te pa sh+yam̐ ka ri ni tra bh+ra ma ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo sho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dha ka ra le hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo tra sa ni ma ra ni pra bha dha ni a pa ra dza ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi dzaṃ ye dza bha na stam̐ bha ni mo ha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra bha ra hi ma ha yo ki ni ka mi sha re kha ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes bya ba dang*/ sngags rings la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod do// gsum pa thun mong gi mchod pa la gsum ste/ mchod/ bstod/ gtor ma'o// mchod pa la bzhi ste/ phyi dang*/ nang dang*/ gsang ba dang*/ de kho na nyid do// dang po la gnyis/ pi wang ma la sogs pa'i lha mo bcu drug nam mkha'i khams gang ba la spros te/

mchod pa ni/ rdo rje lha mo pi wang sbreng*// mtha' gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams// rol pa'i khro bo sku mdog sngo// rje bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mchod// oṃ aṃ badz+ra bha ne hūm̐/ rdo rje lha mo gling bu 'bud// mtha' gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams// rol pa'i khro bo sku mdog ser// rje bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mchod// oṃ aṃ badz+ra wang se hūm̐/ rdo rje lha mo rdza rnga brdung*// mtha' gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams// rol pa'i khro bo sku mdog dmar// rje bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mchod// oṃ aṃ badz+ra mu ran dze hūm̐/ rdo rje lha mo rnga chen brdung*// mtha' gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams// rol pa'i khro bo sku mdog ljang*// rje bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mchod// oṃ aṃ/ badz+ra mu kun dhe hūm̐/ bzhad pa rdo rje lha mo ni// dmar skya phyag gnyis bzhad dang bcas// mtha' gnyis thod pa cang te'u brdung*// gsang ba mchog gis dgyes par rol// oṃ aṃ badz+ra ha se hūm̐/ sgeg pa rdo rje lha mo ni// sngon mo phyag gnyis sgeg dang bcas// mtha' gnyis thod pa cang te'u brdung*// gsang ba mchog gis dgyes par rol// oṃ aṃ badz+ra la s+ye hūm̐/ glu yi rdo rje lha mo ni// ser mo ting ting shag dang bcas// mtha' gnyis thod pa cang te'u brdung*// gsang ba mchog gis dgyes par rol// oṃ aṃ badz+ra ghir ti hūm̐/ gar gyi rdo rje lha mo ni// ljang khu phyag gnyis gar dang bcas// mtha' gnyis thod pa cang te'u brdung*// gsang ba mchog gis dgyes par rol// oṃ aṃ badz+ra nir ti hūm̐// mdog dkar rdo rje me tog ni// g.yas pa me tog cang te'u bsnams// g.yon pa thod pa kha ṭ+wām̐ ga /mchog rnams rdo rje dbyings brnyes mdzod// oṃ aṃ badz+ra pu ṣ+pe hūm̐/ mdog mthing rdo rje bdug spos ni// g.yas na bdug spos cang te'u bsnams// g.yon pa thod pa kha ṭ+wām̐ ga

/mchog rnams rdo rje dbyings brnyes mdzod// oṃ aṃ badz+ra dhu pe hūm̐// mdog dmar rdo rje mar me ni// g.yas na mar me cang te'u bsnams// g.yon na thod pa kha ṭ+wām̐ ga /mchog rnams rdo rje dbyings brnyes mdzod// oṃ aṃ badz+ra dhe pe hūm̐/ mdog dkar rdo rje dril chab ni// g.yas na dri chab cang te'u bsnams// g.yon na thod pa kha ṭ+wam̐ kha// mchog rnams rdo rje dbyings brnyes mdzod// oṃ aṃ badz+ra ghan dhe hūm̐// gzugs kyi rdo rje me long bsnams// dkar mo g.yas na cang te'u bsnams// g.yon na thod pa kha ṭ+wām̐ ga /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ badz+ra dhar she hūm̐// ro yi rdo rje ro snod bsnams// dmar mo g.yas mtha' cang te'u brdung*// g.yon pa thod pa kha ṭ+wam̐ kha// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ a badz+ra ra be hūm̐// reg gi rdo rje na bza' bsnams// ljang khu g.yas mtha' cang te'u brdung*// g.yon pa thod pa kha ṭ+wām̐ ga /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ a badz+ra spar she/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings rdo rje chos 'byung bsnams// dkar mo g.yas mtha' cang te'u brdung*// g.yon pa thod pa kha ṭ+wām̐ ka /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ a badz+ra dha rme hūm̐/ zhes mchod nas/ rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun 'bul ba ni/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// 'khor lo rin chen 'di 'bul bas// srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad de// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rad na pu tsi te a hūm̐/ de nas bde bar gshegs pa 'gre'o// nor bu'i rin chen 'di 'bul bas// bkres zhing 'phongs pa rgyun bcad nas// 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /ma ni rad na pu tsi ti a hūm̐// btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas// ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad nas/ shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs shing*// thabs dang shes rab 'brel par shog

/wa ni te rad na pu tsi te a hūm̐// blon po rin chen 'di 'bul bas// phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan// bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing*// yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /oṃ ma hā ta rad na pu tsi ti a hūm̐// glang po rin chen 'di phul bas// lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal bas// bla med theg pa rab zhon te// thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /oṃ ha ti rad na pu tsi te a hūm̐/ rta mchog rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol te// rdzu 'phrul mchog ni shugs thob nas// sangs rgyas zhing du 'gro bar shog /oṃ du rang ka a sha rad na pu tsi te a hūm̐/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas// nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas// phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad nas// 'jigs bral mchog ni thob par shog /khad ka rad na pu tsi ti a hūm̐/ de dag ni phyi yi mchod pa'o// gnyis pa nang gi mchod pa ni 'dod yon lngas khyab tshad mchod par dmigs te 'bul ba ni/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun nas gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes cig bla med grub mchog stsal tu gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ru pa pu tsa me ga sa mun tra s+pha ra ra na sa me ye hūm̐/ phyogs dus kun nas zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshig brjod sgra snyan ci mchis pa /mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes cig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta la sogs pa'i mthar/ sha pa ta pu tsa me ga sa mun tra s+pha ra na sa ma ya hūm̐/ phyogs dus kun nas tsan dan sbrul snying dang*// a kar la sogs dri mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes cig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// ghan dhe pu tsa me ga sa mun tra s+pha ra na sa ma ye hūm̐// phyogs dus kun nas ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems brtan byed ro mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes cig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// ra sa pu tsa me ga sa mun tra s+pha ra na sa me ye hūṃ/

phyogs dus kun nas 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya khyad par 'phags pa ci mchis pa// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes cig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// spar she pu tsa me ga sa mun tra s+pha ra ra na sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes mchod pa lngas mchod nas/ de nas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa ni lag pa'i mchod pa sngon du ma song na skabs 'dir byas te 'bul bar bya'o// sngon du song na pad ma'i snod nas 'theb srin gyis rang rang gi sngags kyis 'bul bar bya'o// nang gi mchod pa'o// gsum pa gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ lha thams cad gnyis su med par snyoms par zhugs nas/ bde ba chen pos lhag par mnyes par bsam zhing*/ phyag rgya bcas la/ de nas de kho na nyid mchod bya mchod byed dang bral ba'i ngag las mnyam par bzhag go /de ni gsang ba dang de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'o// gnyis pa bstod pa ni/ gong du sngags kyi skabs su bshad pa'i rkang pa brgyad pa gnyis dang*/ oṃ rgyal ba'i sprul pa dus mtha'i me ltar rab tu 'jigs mdzad cing*// ram̐ ram̐ rnam 'phrul ud dpal sngo 'dra nyi ma brgya yi gzi// rdo rje dang ni kha ṭ+wām̐ gar bcas oṃ oṃ dag dang ldan/ tshangs dang lha chen khyab 'jug mgo bcad dbu yi cod pan mdzad// hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa ha ha zhes bya khro bo dang bcas pa'i// mi yi seng ge dregs pa 'joms mdzad 'jigs pa zhabs gnon cing*// a la yi sgra sgrogs bgegs rnams yongs su 'dul bar mdzad// cang te'u sgra sgrogs lha chen khyab 'jug stag gi spags pa bsnams// thugs rje cher sprul rab khros dza hūm̐ bam̐ ho hūm̐ ni mdzad pa can// gangs ri pho mo zhabs kyis mnan cing ku tsar rab tu bzhugs// lha rnams mgo la zhabs kyis mnan nas bde gshegs lnga yi dbu rgyan can// lha rnams thams cad 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs su bskor mdzad pa// hu lu hu lu dziṃ dziṃ treṃ bam̐ rgyu ma'i thod rlon gyis// phreng ba mdzad cing rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'jigs pa khro ba yis// klu sgra mi bzad hu lu hu lus rab tu rmongs mdzad de// rdo rje chen mo ma ma kis ni sku lus rnam par brgyan// dur khrod rab tu 'jigs shing gar gyi 'khor lo'i tshogs skrag mdzad// ka ha ka ha'i bzhad sgra hi hi gnod sbyin skrag rengs mdzad// brkyang bskum tshul gyis bzhugs shing bing ni sha nas lus la rnam par brgyan// bskal pa grangs med rgyun mi chad pa'i dus kyi mthar yang ni// ha na ha na da ha da ha phaṭa kyi mdzad pa can/

stong pa'i ngang las sku gsung thugs kyi sangs rgyas rnam par 'phros// phyin ci log zhen ldang na mtha' dang ma lus med mdzad cing*// gu lu gu lu dziṃ dziṃ yam̐ yam̐ dag gis zhi bar mdzad// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i ting 'dzin thugs ni rnam par smin// bde ba chen po'i mgon po khyod ni mam̐ mam̐ zhes ni mdzad pa can// sems can don du thugs rje chen pos dgyes par mdzad pa po// a li ka li'i rnal 'byor pa yi sdom pa gsang bar mdzad pa can// bcom ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma yi dam tshig ma lus ston par mdzad pa yi// dpal chen he ru ka dpal brtan g.yo'i bdag po de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bya ba la sogs pas ci rigs par bstod par bya'o// gsum pa gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ tshogs kyi yo byad rnams me rlung gi sbyor bas byin gyis brlabs te phud gtor mar 'bul zhing*/ de nas/ ci ltar bshams pa de dag swa bha bas sbyangs te/ yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ kam̐ las thod pa'i sgyid po/ a las snod ka pa la/ nang du gho ku dha ha na/ bhi mu ma ra shu las sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ hūm̐ bh+rum̐ āṃ dziṃ kham̐ las ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid du dmigs te/ oṃ ā hūm̐ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa kha chod kyi tshul du bltas nas/ 'od zer 'phros te ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug cing rdo rje'i thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ a ra li zhes bya ba'i sngags dang*/ so so'i sngags kyis dkyil 'khor 'khor lo la phul te/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gsol bas mnyes par bsam mo// de nas 'jig rten pa rnams la kha kha la sogs pa'i sngags kyis 'byung po rnams la gtor ma sbyin par bya'o// de dag thams cad la pi wang ma la sogs pa'i phyi nang gi mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa'i bye brag ci rigs par bstod do// 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab cing*/ yi ge brgya pas ma tshang ba kha bskang bar bya'o// de nas las byed pas pad ma la sogs pa'i snod du/

thabs shes rab kyi rdzas bzung nas/ ngag tu/ gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos// 'di la the tshom za mi rung*// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa gsum// rang bzhin cig pa nyid du bzhes// a ho su ka zhes brjod do// len pa pos kyang pad bskor dang bcas pas/ bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi mchog /'dod chags la sogs dri ma spangs// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnams par dag /de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal// al la ho zhes blang ngo*// de nas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i rang bzhin gyis nang gi sbyin bsreg ltar longs spyad do// tshogs kyi rnal 'byor ldan pa yis// lha sngags ting 'dzin mi 'bral zhing*// dam tshig rdzas rnams legs par spyad// bde dang stong pa'i don dran bya// tshogs kyi 'khor lor rtsod pa dang*// bag med rgod yang gyur pa spang*// rdo rje'i glu sogs blang bya zhing*// tshul bzhin spyad pas dngos grub 'gyur// de dag ni dngos gzhi'i cho ga'o/ rjes kyi cho ga la lhag ma rnams bsdus la dngos sam yid kyis 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas/ chang gi kha chu btab la yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la a ka ro'i mthar/ oṃ sarba kha kha khā hi khā hi u tsi ta bha ling ta bha k+ṣa si swāhā/ ces pa gsum mam bdun gyis lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po thams cad la sbyin par bya'o// gnyis pa bkra shis brjod pa ni/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung zhing*// he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku// rdo rje phag mo'i pad mar rdo rje rol mdzad ma// bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig phyogs kyi pad ma'i 'dab ma la// rigs kyi yum bzhi dpa' bo phyogs bzhi'i zhal la gzigs// pad ma'i mu khyud gri gug phreng bas rnam par mdzes// bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig mtshams kyi pad ma'i 'dab ma la// byang chub sems dang tsan dan gur gum dri chen chu// dag pa'i snod mchog dga' ba'i reg pa rnam par spyod// bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog

/bkra shis gang zhig nam mkha'i dbyings las legs spyod pa// 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud rdo rje'i phreng*// gnas dang nye ba'i gnas sogs dpa' bo gnyis med rol// bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig sa steng dag la longs spyod pa'i/ 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud pad ma'i phreng*// zhing dang nye ba'i zhing sogs dpa' bo gnyis med rol// bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig 'og 'gro'i gnas la legs spyad pa'i// 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud 'khor lo'i phreng*// 'das dang nye ba'i 'das sogs dpa' bo gnyis med rol// bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig phyogs bzhi dag dang mtshams rnams su// kha gdong la sogs ma mo yid 'ong gzugs gnyis ldan/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad gdag pa kun 'dal ba'i// bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi rnams dang*// yang dag spong ba rdzu 'phrul rkang ba dbang po stobs// byang chubaphyogs rnams sum cu rtsa bdun yongs rdzogs pa'i// bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig rin chen pha gus mdzes pa'i gzhal yas khang*// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab tu brgyan gyur cing*// mu tig rgyan phreng gser gyi dril bu legs dpyad pa'i// bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig rta babs pad ma'i 'khor lo gdags kyis mdzes// ri dwags ba dan bcu drug legs par dpyangs pa la// rlung bskyod pa las chos kyi dril bu'i sgra 'byung ba'i// bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig dar khrod brgyad kyis yongs bskor ba'i// byang chub shing mchog brgyad ni rab tu mdzes gyur cing*// sha za'i gdong gcan brgyad ni rab tu gnas gyur pa'i// bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog

/bkra shis gang zhig ye shes me brgyad 'bar ba dang*// byang chub sems kyi sprin chen brgyad ni 'das pa las// dga' bo la sogs klu chen brgyad ni lhag gyur pa'i// bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig thugs rje'i chu bzhi 'bab pa dang*// kha gdong la sogs gdong chen brgyad kyis yongs su bskor// rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma rnams dar khrod brgyad kyi nang na mdzes// bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /gsum pa bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol ba ni/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// grub pa gsol ba byon pa bzhin// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs su gsol// slar yang byon par mdzad par zhu// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang lha rnams dang*// de sras rnams dang tshangs la sogs// 'jig rten skyong rnams cho ga 'dis// ma tshang ma dag bzod par mdzod// zhi dang bkra shis bde legs shog /yon bdag don chen byas nas su// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas su// slar yang 'byon bar mdzod cig mu// gtso bo nus pa ma mchis shing*// ma 'tshal ba'am ma rnyed pas// ma tshang pa'am lhag gyur pa// byas pa de ni bzod par mdzod// gsang sngags nyams dang bya ba nyams// cho ga nyams par gyur pa rnams// de ni lha mos bzod par 'os// mnga' bdag ma yis gnang bar zhu// lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad// de yi gsung brjod mchog tu tshad// bden pa de dag gis lha mos// bdag dang rjes 'dzin rgyu ru shog /ces brjod/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yi ge brgya pa'i sngags bzlas te bsdu bar bya'o// 'dir brjod pa'i rim pa yis// zab mo'i rim pa ji lta bar// 'khor lo sngon da'ang gang gsungs pa// gzhan du thams cad bya ba nyid// zla phyed ngo yi tshes bcu la// gnyis khar lha mo mchod par bya// gzhon nu ma'am rnal 'byor ma/ rtag tu cho ga bzhin tshim bya/ zhes gsungs pa'i rim pa rnams la man ngag ji lta ba bzhin du dar bar bya'o// bzhi pa de ltar mchod pa'i bsod nams de dag nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i don da/

bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur bsngo bar bya'o// de dag ni rjes kyi cho ga'o// bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i phyi rol gyi mchod pa'i cho ga gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so// 'di bkod dge bas bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams// he ru ka dpal bde stong gnyis su med pa'i dpal// 'bras bu'i mnga' bdag de dang gnyis su med gyur cing*// thabs kyi rol pas srid zhi gnyis su gar byed shog /'di las 'gal 'khrul gyur pa rnams// bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ sbrul lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu la lha stengs kyi ri khrod du rang byung rdo rjes dar ba'o// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling brgyan du shog// / ༈ bde mchog lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang gi cho ga bzhugs so// bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig kun du rtog pa'i yid// lam du zhugs te 'ching byed pa'i// mchog mtha' dbu ma'i lam gyis ni// don ston de la phyag 'tshal lo// yid kyi rgyun ni bzlog bya'i phyir// rgyu la 'bras bu'i rgyas gdab pa// lam du nges par snang ba'i thabs// bla ma'i gsung ltar bshad par bya// slob dpon slob ma gnas dang das// yo byad yongs su tshang nas ni// rnam gsum rnam pa bcu bzhi yi// tshul gyis bsgrub bya gzhan du min// de la 'dir bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa lha bcu gsum pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar 'dod pas/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis grangs dang mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa rdzogs shing*/ slob ma bzang pos gsol ba gdab pa sngon du 'gro bas/ las la gsum ste/ sa chog /sta gon/ dngos gzhi'o// dang po la bzhi/ sa slang ba dang*/ brtag pa dang*/ dang ba dang*/ bsrung zhing byin gyis brlabs pa'o// dang po ni dkyil 'khor gang du bri ba'i gnas der tshom bu dgod cing*/ mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams te/

lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas sa'i lha mo ser mo lag na bum pa thogs pa bskyed cing dgug ste/ chu bzhi dang mchod pa lngas mchod cing bstod de gsol ba gdab pa ni/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul gyis khyad par ni// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// shākya seng ge skyob pa yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gis bdud stobs bcom// rgyal bar byas nas dkyil 'khor bri// zhes brjod pas gnang ba byin par bsam zhing*/ phyogs de'i gzhi bdag la gtor ma byin par bya'o// de nas gnyis pa brtag pa ni// dkar po la sogs kha dog lnga// shing dong gyo dum gsegs ma sogs// skyon rnams kun dang rab bral ba// de ni shis pa'i mtshan ma brjod// gsum pa dang ba ni/ swa bha ba'i sngags dang rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya sa la bsnun cing*/ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes nyes pa'i tshogs dang ngo*// de nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i stegs bu legs par byas te/ nyi ma dang po'i bya ba'o// de nas nyi ma gnyis pa'i snga dro/ bzhi pa bsrung zhing byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dag cing rgyan bgos te/ las byed pas shar phyogs nas/ mchod pa dang bstod pa'i yan lag ci rigs su byas nas bskul ba ni/ mkha' 'gro ma yi nga rgyal gyis// de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor gtso bo bshad du gsol// ces so// yang byang phyogs nas la ma'i nga rgyal gyis// sems can kun gyi sems chen po// rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med// kun tu bzang po thugs kyi mchog /dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol// zhes so// nub phyogs nas dam skyes ma'i nga rgyal gyis/ zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung*// ye shes spyod pa rnam dong ba// kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog

/dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol// zhes so// lho phyogs nas gzugs can ma'i nga rgyal gyis// mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs// mtshan min thams cad rnam par spangs// kun tu bzang po ku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol// zhes so// de nas rkang pa gnyis su hūṃ las rdo rje dang mig gnyis su ma dang ta las zla ba dang nyi ma bsams te/ rdo rje'i lta bas thams cad du bltas la g.yon gyis dril bu bzung*/ g.yas kyis rdo rje gsor zhing kha ṭ+wām̐ ga legs par 'khyud nas bgegs bskrad par bya'o// sa phyogs 'dir sems can gyi don rtsom gyis/ lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang*/ dri za dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ sha za dang*/ srin po la sogs pa gnas kyi bdag po gang su yang rung ba khyod byer cig /myur du song cig /'di ltar dpal he ru ka'i bka' thos nas myur ba nyid du song cig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag nga'i rdo rje 'bar ba dang*/ kha ṭ+wām̐ ga 'dis spyi bo rnam pa brgyar 'gas par bya'o zhes brjod do// g.yas brkyang g.yon brkyang sa ga zlum// mnyam pa'i rkang stabs la sogs pa'i// gar gyis kun tu bskor bya zhing*// bgegs la sogs pa bskrad par bya// zhal bzhi la sogs sngags kyis ni// phur bu dra ba gur bya'o// 'di dag gis ni sa'i cho ga'o// gnyis pa sta gon la bzhi las/ lha sta gon dang*/ bum pa dang*/ sbyin bsreg dang*/ slob ma sta gon no// dang po la gsum las gdan dgod pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dri'i thig le lha grangs dang mnyam pa dgod cing*/ tshom bu mnyam pa bkod nas mchod pa bsham/ gnyis pa bskyed cing mchod bstod bya ba ni/ bdud rtsi myang ba sngon du 'gro bas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rten dang brten par bcas pa bskyed la/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug cing*/ mchod pa dang bstod pa ci rigs su bya'o// gsum pa snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ gnyis med ye shes las byung pa// khyab bdag dngos kun bdag nyid can// ston pa gtso bo khrag 'thung dpal// phag mo lhan cig yang dag ldan// gang zhig phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang*// rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can// byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// slob ma la ni phan pa dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// rdo rje can bdag 'di bzhes pas// nang par dkyil 'khor bri bgyi 'tshal// rjes su brtse bar nyer dgongs te// nye ba ru ni mdzad pa'i rigs// zhes snyan gsan dbab nas/

gnang ba byin par bsam mo// gnyis pa bum pa sta gon ni/ legs par bshams te/ bdag bskyed pa dang tha dad med par bum pa gzhal yas khang gi rnam pa'i nang da/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa bskyed la/ bzlas pa'i man ngag ltar bsnyen par bya'o// las bum la bgegs mthar byed dang*/ khan dha ro hi gang rung bskyed cing bzlas pa bya'o// de dag thams cad la mchod bstod ci rigs pa byas te/ slar ye shes kyi chur byin gyis brlab po// sbyin bsreg ni gzhan du shes so// bzhi pa slob ma sta gon du gnas pa la gnyis te/ dor ba dang sta gon dngos so// dang po la gsum las/ thog mar khrus bya zhing maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rdo rje khros pa mdzes pa yi// bdag gi ston pa dga' chen khyod// sems can kun gyi don brtson pa// mgon po dam tshig bdag la stsol// bsgom pa'i chos kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la rtsol// kun du rtog pa spangs pa yi// grong khyer nyams dgar 'jug par 'tshal// zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab po// de nas gnyis pa slob ma rnams gzhan don la bskul ba ni/ 'di ltar lam theg pa chen po la 'jug par byed pa la/ gzhan don du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i bsam pa rtse gcig pa dgos so zhes gdams pa ni/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni gzhug par bya// bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan// gzhan ni 'jig rten pha rol gnyer// slar yang dad dang ldan pa yis// 'jig rten pha rol la dmigs nas// blo ldan dkyil 'khor gzhug par bya// 'di yi 'bras bu don gnyer na// 'jig rten pha rol 'grub mi 'gyur// 'jig rten pha rol la dmigs nas// 'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub*// zhes pas/ 'di ltar don da gnyer ba bsam pa brtan po dang ldan pas/ myur du sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur te/

das gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyang lam zab mo 'di la brten nas 'bras bu mngon du brnyes pa yin pas/ khyed rnams kyang de ltar bsgrubs shig /ces brjod de/ bu tshur theg pa chen po la// khyed ni tshul chen snod yin te// gsang sngags spyod pa'i cho ga ni// khyod la yang dag bshad par bya// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// de bzhin du yang ma byon dang*// da ltar byung ba'i dpa' bo gang*/ 'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa kun// de dag kun gyis gsang ba yis// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas// dpa' bos byang chub shes rab kyis// lus dang gnyis med kun mkhyen mnyes// gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med mnyes// skyob pa dpal ldan he ru kas// bdud sde shin tu mi zad pa'i// stobs chen dag kyang de yis bcom// de bas kun mkhyen gnyis med pa'i// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces de dag gi don yang cung zad bshad do// de nas gsum pa ni gnyis las/ dang por tshogs bsags pa'i don du yan lag bdun pa byas te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ bla ma rnams dmigs la mchod pa rnams kyis mchod la phyag 'tshal te/ sdig pa bshags/ bsod nams la rjes su yid rang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab/ lam rten cing dge ba gzhan don du bsngo ba'i bsam pa bskyed de/ lad mo gyis zhes brjod de/ phyogs bcu das gsum bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang*// yi dam lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas// tha ma da lta thug gi bar// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis// lus ngag yid gsum sgo nas ni// sdig pa dpag med bgyis pa dang*// bgyid du bstsal dang yid rang ngo*// khyed kyi spyan sngar bshags par bgyid// slan chad bdag ni mi bgyid do// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// 'phags pa rang rgyal nyan thos kyis// yan lag rnams kyang bzung bar bgyid// 'gro rnams kun gyi dge ba la// bdag ni rjes su yid rang ngo*// bde gshegs chos sku la bzhugs te// 'gro ba kun la phan don da// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba bgyi/

bdag ni rtag tu gsol ba 'debs// bde gshegs mdzad pa mthar phyin nas// mya ngan 'da' bar bzhed pa la// bskal pa'i mtha' mar bzhugs par ni /bdag ni rtag tu gsol ba 'debs// lus ngag yid gsum dge ba de// bgyis sam bgyid du stsal pa gang*// rjes su yid rang de dag ni// 'gro rnams kun gyis thob par shog /bde mchog shes rab bdag nyid can// bla mar bcas pa thams cad la// bdag ni rtag tu gsol ba 'debs/ bdag gis lus 'di 'bul ba yis// theg pa dman la mi 'jug cing*// theg mchog bla na med pa yi// lam cig bdag la bstan du gsol// zhes brjod de/ de'i rjes su gnyis pa skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa'i cho ga rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa sbyin par bya'o// shin tu bsdus par byed na/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi drung da/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed pa'i bsam pas ngag tu brjod pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// ci ltar das gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag ni bskyed par bgyi// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams grol bar bgyi// dbugs ma phyung rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod// ces lan gsum mo// gnyis pa sta gon dngos la lnga las/ dang po rigs brtag pa'i don du so shing sbyin pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal lta bu'i steng du dor du gzhug pa ni/ slob dpon gyis oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod la sbyin par bya'o// de nas de'i rtse mos so 'bru ba tsam dang*/ sos nem tsam byas la thal mo'i bar du bcug nas/ mdun drang por dor bar bya'o// de'i rtse mo gyen du 'greng na/ mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro// shar du bltas na grub chen brgyad 'byung la/

lhor bltas na 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub 'grub la/ nub tu bltas na chos smra ba la dbang bar 'gyur zhing*/ byang du bltas na 'phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par 'gyur ro// thur du bltas na sa 'og gi dngos grub 'grub po// yang phyogs bzhi la 'phrin las rnam bzhi la shis par bstan no// gnyis pa dri ma dag pa'i don du skyor chu blud pa ni/ ma da na byin gyi brlabs la/ hub re 'thung du bcug nas/ ngag tu/ oṃ bi hri de bhud dha dharmā pa pam̐ na ma d+ya sho dha ya/ sarba pi ka rma sa ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod do// gsum pa bar chad zhi bar don du bsrung skud gdags pa ni/ skud pa dmar po la sngags kyi mdud pa re byas la skyes pa'i dpang pa g.yon dang*/ bud med kyi g.yas la gdags so// bzhi pa rmi lam brtag pa ni don du ku sha sbyin la/ ku sha'i chun po gnyis byas la cig lag pa g.yas su gtad la/ badz+ra swa twa zhes bya'o// cig g.yon du gtad la badz+ra tig ṇa zhes brjod de/ gnas de nyid du g.yas kyi ku sha sngas su bcug la/ g.yon gyi ku sha stan 'og tu bcug nas nyal la rmi lam thob cig ces bya'o// lnga pa spro dga' bskyed pa'i don du zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos bshad pa ni/ khyed rnams ma yengs par nyon cig byas la/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// thams cad mkhyen pa 'byung mi 'gyur// rgya lam na yang res 'ga' zhig /u dam 'bar ba'i me tog bzhin// 'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung srid// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gnyis med zab mo'i spyod tshul 'dis// sems can sangs rgyas byed pa yin// bskal pa grangs med mang por ni// sngon byas pa yi sdig pa gang*// de kun zad par 'gyur ba ni// zab mo'i dkyil 'khor mthong bas so// zhes brjod pa'i don yang cung zad bshad do// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod bstod dang tshogs dang gtor ma byas te/

nang par gyi das su rmi lam dris la rmi lam ngan na zhal bzhi pa'i sngags kyis bzlog par bya'o// bzang po rmi na dngos grub rab phyag rgya chen po/ 'bring grub chen brgyad tha ma yang tshe dang longs spyod 'grub bo// zhes lung bstan/ de dag ni nub gnyis pa'i cho ga'o// gsum pa dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga la gnyis te/ dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba dang*// dbang bskur ba'o// dang po la thig gdab pa dang*/ bcu gsum gyi bdag nyid can gyi dkyil 'khor bri zhing phyag mtshan dgod pa'i bar tshogs pas/ dkyil 'khor bri ba'o// gnyis pa dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la gnyis las/ dam tshig bsgrub pa ni/ mchod pa la sogs pa bshams te/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis mchod pa sngon du 'gro bas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bskyed do// de nas man ngag bzhin du ye shes pa bkug cing*/ sta gon gyi lha dang gnyis su med par byas te/ de nyid du gzhug par bya'o// de nas mchod pa dang gtor ma la sogs pas legs par brgyan pa'o// gnyis pa slob dpon bdag nyid dbang byin brlabs dang ldan par bsgrub pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gsal bar dmigs pa'i mdun du mchod pa la sogs pa sngon da7ུ song bas tshigs su bcad pa 'don ste/ nam mkha' las byung mtshan ldan phyir// thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin// bde mchog 'khor lo bdag bsgrub mdzod// dkon mchog yon tan chen po ste// dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha// rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal// mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod// nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa ste// 'dod chags kun gyi rjes chags pa// 'dod chags chen po dga' ba che// bcom ldan de nyid bdag grub mdzod// shin tu dga' ba'i kun gyi mchog gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs// kun tu bzang po bdag nyid can// byang chub sems dpa' bdag grub mdzod// kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste// dbang phyug chen po phyag rgya mchog

/grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa// rdo rje snyems pa bdag grub mdzod// sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa// sems can kun gyi yid la gnas// sems can kun gyi yab nyid de// 'dod chags mchog gi dam tshig mchog /ces so// de nas tshigs su bcad pa rnams kyis bden pa'i byin brlabs bya ste/ shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor da// bden pa gang gi ye shes mchog /bden pa de yis mgon khyod kyis// bdag gi 'dod pa yongs rdzogs mdzod// chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las la kun tu 'byung*// de bzhin de kho nyid las byung*// bden pa 'di yis dkyil 'khor da// gzugs brnyan gsal ba slob ma ni// kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog /ces so// de nas cho ga'i rim pa ci rigs pas ngag tu brjod cing ting nge 'dzin gtso che ba'i tshul gyis dbang blang bar bya'o// da ni dbang bskur ba dngos la gsum/ 'jug pa dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes so// dang po la phyi nang gnyis las phyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa la lnga las/ dang po ni las kyi bum pas khrus byas te/ maṇ+ḍal phul zhing yol ba'i phyi rol du gnas pa la/ slob dpon gyis kun la/ kye dga' zhing sdug pa khyod su yin zhes dri bar bya/ de nas kun gyis kye bde ba chen po/ bdag ni skal ba bzang po bo zhes lan gsum brjod do// sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig nod 'tshal lo// khyod ni de ltar yin phan chod 'khor lo bde mchog dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor du sems bskyed cig ces brjod/ gnyis pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rgyas par byed na kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can la sogs pa bya'o// bye brag tu/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo// rnal 'byor gnas la bdag phyag 'tshal// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal// ces so// de nas slob dpon gyis de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog

/snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi// zhes brjod nas gdong bcing ste nang du gzhug par bya'o// gsum pa phyag bya ba ni/ rim pa ltar gnas gsum du phyag bya ste/ oṃ na ma te hūm̐/ na ma mi hūm̐ swā hā/ na mo na ma hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes phyag bya'o// bzhi pa bdun rnam dag dang sems bskyed pa ni/ sta gon gyi skabs nas bshad pa ltar ram/ yang na sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i bsam pa bskyed de/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yid rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi// 'gro ba kun gyi don gyi phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ zhes lan gsum gyis thun mong gi sems bskyed do// de nas rigs lnga'i dam tshig dang sdom pa sbyin pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// 'di ni sangs rgyas rigs yid 'ong*// sdom pa brtan par 'gyur pa yin// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya ni// blo chen khyod kyis bzung bar bya// byang chub sems gang de rdo rje// shes rab dril bu zhes bsgrags so// slob dpon khyod kyis bzung byas te// bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig sdom pa yin par bshad// rin chen rigs gsal rtag tu ni// nyin re bzhin du lan drug tu// chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs byams// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rab tu sbyin// phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos kyang ma lus gzung*// 'di ni pad ma'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba'o// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bya// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// zhes brjod cing khas blang ngo*// de nas khyad par gyi sems bskyed pa ni/

slob ma lhar bsam pa'i snying khar zla ba'i steng du rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la sems gtod la bde stong du zhog cig ces brjod de/ oṃ yo ga tsita u pa ta ya mi/ su ra ta sa ma ya stam̐/ bho dhe tsi ta badz+ra ya ta su kham̐/ deng rdo rje rnal 'byor sems bskyed cig ces brjod do// lnga pa ni skyes pa la dpa' bo'i go cha/ bud med la dpa' mo'i go chas bsrung bar bya'o// de dag ni phyi'i 'jug pa'o// gnyis pa nang gi 'jug pa la gnyis te/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi'o// dang po la gsum las/ phan yon bsgrags pa ni/ deng khyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ ngas khyod la dpal he ru ka'i sems bskyed par byas te/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ dpa' mo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta ci zhig smos kyis/ khyod kyis 'khor lo ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du brjod par mi bya ste/ dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyis// snying la yang dag zhugs pa ni// gal te tshul 'di smra na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// ces so// gnyis pa chu blud pa ni/ ma ḍa ṇam̐ lce thog tu bzhag ste/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'thob/ oṃ pañtsa a mri ta mud kha ka ṭha ṭha ṭha hūm̐/ gsum pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dam tshig ni/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyis/ gang ngas 'di byos shig ces bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya'o// khyod nga la brnyas par ma byed cig khyod mi bde ba ma spangs par dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar gyur ta re/ gnyis pa dngos grub la drug las/ dang po ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas ngag tu/ dpa' po dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis brlobs la/

dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab par mdzod cig ces brjod do// de nas gnyis pa lus kyi gnad dang ting nge 'dzin 'brel pas ji skad bshad pa'i bdug spos bsreg cing*/ sngags kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dbab par bya'o// ji srid phebs pa'i mtshan ma ma byung gi bar du'o// gsum pa rdo rje'i glu blang ba ni/ ltos shig rang gi sems la ltos// sems nyid cir yang grub pa med// grub pa med pa'i sems nyid 'di// sna tshogs snang ba ngo mtshar che// snang tsam nyid na sems su 'dug /sems rnams kun gyi de nyid ni// bde ba chen po'i ye shes yin// rnam par mi rtog bsam mi khyab// gsal ba de yi ngo bor snang*// mos pa du ma'i sems can la// thabs rnams sna tshogs bstan pa ste// sna tshogs sgyu ma'i sbyor ba yis// dpa' bo seng ge bzhin du spyod// bsam gyis mi khyab go 'phang thob// 'di bla ma rnams kyi byin brlabs yin// sna tshogs nor bu ji bzhin du// skal ldan rnams kyi spyod yul 'gyur// zhes brjod la dril bu'i sgra lta bu la sems gtod la rtse cig tu klod la zhog cig ces bya'o// bzhi pa me tog dor ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs bsal zhing dbus snang bar byas la/ me tog thal mo'i bar du bcug cing brkyang la/ khyod kyi skye ba snga ma'i las 'phro yod pa'i yi dam lha la phog par gyur cig snyam du sems la dril bu bsil ba dang*/ dor cig byas la 'di skad du/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi// lha rnams kyi ni rigs ci bzhin// ji ltar bsod nams de bzhin shog /prañdza dzi badz+ra ho zhes brjod do// gnyis pa slob dpon gyi rigs gang la phog pa brtags la blangs pas/ lha de me tog dang gnyis su med par bsams la/ slob ma'i spyi bor bstims nas/ 'di skad do// sems can stobs chen khyod kyis ni// 'di ni rab tu gzung bar gyis// zhes brjod de/

dbus su ni zhe sdang rdo rje/ lha mo bzhi la ni ser sna rdo rje/ sgo mtshams ma rnams la ni phrag dog rdo rja/ lnga pa spyan dbye ba ni/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson ma mdzad// mig ni yang dag 'byed mdzad de// rdo rje mig ni bla na med// oṃ badz+ra ne tra a pa ha ra pa ḍa laṃ hri/ drug pa dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs// 'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dang*// dngos grub phun tshogs khyod mngon 'gyur// dam tshig thams cad bskyang pa dang*/ gsang sngags la yang brtson par gyis/ zhes bya ba dang kyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam par dag pa la sogs pa bstan to// de dag ni nang gi 'jug pa'o// da ni dbang bskur ba dngos la gsum las/ dang po gsol ba gdab pa ni/ phyag byas te maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ 'di skad du/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob phyir gzi brjid can// ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas stsal// de bzhin bdag la deng stsol cig /zhes lan gsum mo// gnyis pa dbang la bzhi las/ thog ma bum dbang la gnyis te/ dngos dang*/ de dang rjes su 'brel pa'i rdo rje slob dpon no// dang po la lnga las/ chu dbang ni rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor slob ma'i lus gzhug cing*/ ting nge 'dzin brtan te/ ci ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// zhes rtsa ba'i sngags dang a bhi ṣiñtsa tu mam̐ zhes brjod de/ de de rigs drug pa 'khor lo bde mchog 'khor lo'i dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po mi dmigs pa las/ me long lta bu'i ye shes su gnas gyur pa la dbang ba'i nus pa bskyed/

rigs drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' yis dbu rgyan par bsgom zhes brjod do// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rin chen rigs su mngon par dgug cing bstim ste cod pan gyi dbang sbyin pa ni/ ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis brgyan pa// sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yis// rin chen dag pa'i dbu rgyan dang*// dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin bar bya// oṃ shrī rat+na he he ru ru kam̐ kam̐ la sogs pas dbang bskur// de nas snang ba mtha' yas pad ma he ru ka'i rnam par dgug cing*/ rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba ni/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur bas// de ring khyod ni dbang bskur te// 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad de// rab tu grub phyir rdo rje long*// pad ma he ru ka zhes pa'i sngags kyis dbang bskur ro// de nas don yod grub pa he ru ka'i rang bzhin du dgug cing*/ dril bu'i dbang bskur ba ni/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed// kar ma he he ru ru kam̐ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis dbang bskur ro// de nas rnam par snang mdzad he ru ka'i rang bzhin du dgug cing rdo rje dang dril bus 'khyud pa'i tshul du byas te ming gi dbang bskur ba ni/ rdo rje dril bus yang dag 'khyud// g.yon snyems ma dang sgros 'dzin ma// gnyis med gnyis 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag /phyag rgya chen por byin gyis brlabs// shri bhud dha he he ru ru kam̐ zhes bya ba'i sngags dang*/ kye dpal rdo rje ge mo de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i rjes su gnang ba gsum ste/ thog mar rdo rje'i brtul shugs ni/ slob ma he ru kar gsal ba'i lag pa g.yas su dam tshig gi rdo rje byin nas/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de// he ru ka dpal phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// he ru ka dpal brtul shugs can// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid dhi badz+ra sa ma ya ti staṃ/

e sha tam̐ dha ra ya mi hūm̐ ha ha ha ha ho ho/ zhes sbyin no// de nas spyod pa dang 'brel ba'i rjes gnang ni/ kha ṭ+wām̐ ga la sogs pa lag tu gtad de/ 'di skad do// he ru ka dpal kha ṭ+wām̐ ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍa ma ru// rdo rje kha ṭ+wām̐ rdo rjer bcas// dril bu sil sil sgra sgrogs pa// mchod phyir thogs dang rnal 'byor bdag /kha ṭ+wām̐ kha dang rnal 'byor snod// dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis// de nas sngags kyi rjes gnang ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// rtsa ba'i sngags dang yang dag ldan// nyi shu rtsa bzhi sngags kyis ni// snying po'i dbang bskur sbyin par bya// zhes snying po'i rjes gnang lan gsum sbyin par bya'o/ de dag ni bum pa'i dbang ngo*// gal te dbang gong ma gsum po bskur bar 'dod na/ 'di nyid kyi skabs su bskur bar bya'o// de nas bum dbang rjes su 'brel pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur bar 'dod na/ khyad par ni 'di yin te/ dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su chos kyi khri stan la 'dug tu bcug nas/ he ru ka nyid du bsgrub cing chu dbang la sogs pa sngon du 'gro bas/ dngos gzhi ni/ rdo rje dril bu slob ma'i mgo thog tu bzhag nas/ rdo rje rab gnas rdo rje nyid// che dang dril bu chen po zung*// de ring rdo rje slob dpon 'gyur// slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis// dus 'di nas khyod kyi 'phrin las bzhi'i sgo nas sems can la dbang bskur ba dang*/ rgyud pa gzhan la sogs pa'i sgo nas don gyis shig /ces so// de nas lag pa g.yas su rdo rje gtad de/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag badz+ra swa twa hūm̐ zhes so/ de nas g.yon par dril bu gtad de/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog

/dam pa'i sems dpa' byed par 'gyur// zhes so/ de nas rus pa'i rgyan gtad de/ 'khor lo thod pa rna cha dang*// mgul rgyan gdub gu ske rags dang*// do shal dang ni rna rgyan te// phyag rgya yis ni dbang bskur ro// zhes bya ba dang*/ rgyas par ni rigs lnga dang pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi rnam par dag pa bshad do// mchod pa lngas kyang slob ma la yang dag par mchod do// de nas rigs lnga'i sgo nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gnang ba ni/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// ci ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba// chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor// de bzhin du rdo rje'i 'khor lo/ nor bu'i 'khor lo/ pad ma'i 'khor lo/ las kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ zhes sbyar ro// de nas 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang ni/ zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar bya dang gnon sogs dang*// bsod dang bskrod pa thams cad de// las de rnams ni bsgrub par bgyi// ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang*/ mchil lham de bzhin ri lu ste// rnal 'byor ma yi dngos grub ni// de ni ci dga' bsgrub par gyis/ rgyas par byed na gzhan rjes su gnang ba rnams kyang nag po pa las byung pa bzhin no// de nas bum dbang dang rjes su 'brel ba'i lung bstan pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis chos gos seng ge'i rna ba ltar byas nas me'i phyag rgya byas te mgo la bzhag nas lung bstan pa ni/ 'di ni ngas khyod lung bstan te// he ru ka dpal de bzhin gshegs// dngos po mchog tu dag bya'i phyir// srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton// shri he ru ka ma sarba ta thā ga ta/ sid dhi sa ma yang stam̐/ bhur bhu ba swa/ kye dpal rdo rje che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o zhes lung bstan no// gsang dbang dang rjes su 'brel ba'i dbugs dbyung ba ni/ lag pa spyi bor bzhag ste/ khams gsum kun gyi rgyal srid che// rgyal ba'i bdag por bstan pa dang*// de ring bdud las rnam rgyal zhing*// pho brang mchog tu zhugs pa yin// deng ni sangs rgyas nyid thob par// khyed rnams 'dir ni the tshom med// ces so// bzhi pa dang rjes su 'brel ba'i gzengs bstod pa ni/

bde chen theg pa 'di la ni// phyin chad 'chi ba yod ma yin// srid pa shin tu dag pas na// srid pa'i sdug bsngal las 'das so// zhes rjes su gnang ba sbyin par bya'o// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong la tshogs dang gtor ma rgyas par byas te/ 'byung po la lhag mas tshim par byas nas/ bkra shis dang smon lam rgyas par bya'o// lha bcu gsum pa'i dbang gi cho ga ye shes kyi chu rgyun zhes bya ba rdzogs so// t+gu'i pa dang dbyer med lto ngar pa// a ba dhu ti te pu ras chung zhabs// zangs ri pa dang 'gro mgon pong brag pa// dharma ghu ru sam̐ gha la k+ṣa yi// mdzad srol 'di ni rang byung rdo rjes sbyar// me tri pas mdzad bsgrub pa'i thabs dang ni// rab gnas gzhung dang lo rgyus rnam pa gsum// mngon rtogs dbang chu 'di rnams phyogs gcig go /mchod 'phreng sbyin bsreg bzlas pa'i man ngag dang*// lag mchod gtor ma gzhan dang mthun pa'o// 'di las 'gal dang nor 'khrul gyur pa rnams// bla ma mkha' 'gro tshogs la bzod par gsol// de las byung ba'i dge ba dri med pas// 'gro rnams rdo rje 'chang chen thob par shog /sbrul lo zla ba bcu pa'i yar tshes la// lha stengs su sbyar ba 'di/ rdzogs so/// /
